jobs.title: Assistanat Manager - Research And Development
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Assistant Manager – Research & Development (R&D)**

**Company:**
Deconstruct

**Location:**
Bangalore – HSR Layout

**Role Type:**
Full-time

**About Deconstruct**

We’re a D2C skincare brand built on one belief: safe, sensible, honest skincare. No fairy-tale marketing. No filler ingredients. Just actives that work. We’re looking for an execution-focused, scientifically rigorous
**Assistant Manager – R&D**
who can own our innovation pipeline end to end, from formulation and claims to quality and launch, and help build science-backed skincare that delivers real results.

**What you’ll own**

* Own the end-to-end NPD and renovation pipeline and deliver
  **10–12 new product launches a year**
  on time against the product launch calendar.
* Lead formulation development for new launches and existing SKU renovations, from ingredient evaluation and optimization through compatibility studies to the final formula.
* Ensure seamless pilot batches and commercial scale-ups with third-party manufacturers, with zero RM- or PM-related challenges.
* Ensure every product meets its accelerated stability, freeze-thaw, compatibility and long-term stability requirements, and maintain
  **zero critical consumer complaints**
  across launched products.
* Develop all products within the target cost in the product brief, and drive cost optimization without compromising quality.
* Lead
  **claims substantiation**
  across existing SKUs and at brand level. This includes planning and running efficacy, consumer perception and in-vitro/clinical studies with testing partners, and extending claims in line with brand and NPD goals.
* Explore and develop
  **potential RM blends**
  with ingredient suppliers to build product differentiation.
* Turn technical and claims data into consumer-relevant communication for Brand, Marketing and Customer Service teams.
* Deliver technical content for PDPs, social media campaigns, blogs, label artworks and marketing communications.
* Own
  **GRN approvals**
  for raw materials within TAT, and work with Quality to keep incoming material standards high.
* Run weekly cross-functional reviews with Brand, CS, Supply Chain, Procurement, Packaging, Quality and Regulatory, as well as with RM and FG vendors, to deliver OTIF.
* Maintain and update NPD project trackers, ensure no deviation from standard SOPs, and drive continuous improvement in development processes.
* Manage formulation partners, CDMOs and ingredient suppliers, and evaluate new vendors and technologies.
* Guide and review the work of R&D associates and interns, and support their technical growth.
* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, formulation records and product specifications, and support regulatory and artwork approvals.

**What we’re looking for**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cosmetic Technology, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of hands-on experience in skincare, cosmetics, personal care or pharmaceutical formulation development.
* A proven track record of taking multiple products from brief to commercial launch with third-party manufacturers.
* Strong expertise in emulsion systems, active ingredients, stability testing, scale-up and commercialization.
* Hands-on exposure to claims substantiation, including efficacy studies, testing labs and claim support documentation.
* Ability to manage a high-volume NPD pipeline in parallel without compromising timelines, quality or cost.
* Strong vendor management, project management and cross-functional stakeholder skills.
* Ability to explain complex science in clear, consumer-friendly language.
* Experience mentoring or guiding junior team members is an advantage.
* Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

**What We Offer**

* **Compensation:**
  Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards and experience.
* **Growth:**
  Ownership of the brand’s innovation pipeline, working directly with leadership and cross-functional teams on products from concept to launch.
* **Culture:**
  A fast-paced, collaborative, science-driven and ownership-focused environment with plenty of room to learn, innovate and grow.

**ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATION**

* Experience in D2C skincare, beauty, cosmetics or FMCG brands is preferred.
* Experience running claims substantiation or clinical/efficacy studies is highly desirable.
* Exposure to BIS/CDSCO cosmetic regulations and claim compliance will be an added advantage.
* Candidates with a strong passion for skincare innovation, emerging ingredients and consumer-centric product development will be given preference.

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
Hiring: Head Chef – Arabian Cuisine & Product Development (R&D)

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
5+ years preferred

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and passionate
**Arabian Cuisine Chef**
, preferably with expertise in traditional Middle Eastern cooking and Arabic bread preparation, to join our team.

This is a specialised culinary development role focused on creating authentic recipes, developing new menu items, standardising food preparation processes and building comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for our restaurant operations.

The ideal candidate should have strong practical knowledge of Arabian cuisine, an understanding of traditional cooking techniques and the ability to translate culinary expertise into standardised, repeatable processes that can be implemented across multiple restaurant outlets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Recipe Development & Menu Innovation**

* Develop authentic Arabian and Middle Eastern recipes.
* Create and refine recipes for Mandi, grilled meats, Alfaham, Shawarma, BBQ, kebabs, marinades, sauces, dips and other Arabian specialities.
* Experiment with ingredients, spices, cooking techniques and flavour profiles.
* Develop new menu items while maintaining authenticity and consistency.
* Conduct food trials, tasting sessions and product evaluations.

**2. Arabic Bread & Bakery Specialisation**

* Develop recipes and preparation methods for traditional Arabic breads.
* Expertise in Khubz, Pita, Saj, Khameer, Tannour and other Middle Eastern breads is highly desirable.
* Standardise dough preparation, fermentation, proofing, baking temperatures and cooking techniques.
* Establish consistent bread quality, texture, thickness and shelf life.

**3. SOP Development & Standardisation**

* Create detailed recipe documentation with exact ingredient quantities and preparation procedures.
* Develop step-by-step SOPs for food preparation, cooking, storage and handling.
* Establish standard portion sizes, cooking times, temperatures and plating specifications.
* Develop batch preparation methods for commercial kitchen operations.
* Ensure recipes are scalable and consistently reproducible across multiple outlets.

**4. Kitchen Training & Implementation**

* Train kitchen staff on newly developed recipes and preparation techniques.
* Demonstrate standardised cooking procedures.
* Establish quality control and consistency benchmarks.
* Monitor implementation of SOPs within kitchen operations.

**5. Food Costing & Quality Control**

* Assist in ingredient selection and sourcing.
* Develop recipes with commercial viability and cost efficiency in mind.
* Calculate recipe yields, portion costs and wastage.
* Maintain consistency in taste, presentation and product quality.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Minimum 5 years of professional culinary experience preferred.
* Strong specialisation in Arabian, Middle Eastern or Gulf cuisine.
* Previous experience working in Gulf countries (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Oman or Bahrain) is highly preferred.
* Strong expertise in traditional Arabic bread making is an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in recipe development and menu creation.
* Ability to document recipes and create structured kitchen SOPs.
* Experience training and managing kitchen teams.
* Good understanding of commercial kitchen operations, food costing and standardisation.

Who We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in chefs who understand the difference between simply preparing food and developing a consistent, commercially scalable food product.

The candidate should be passionate about authentic Arabian cuisine, detail-oriented, experimental and capable of building structured culinary systems from the ground up.

**Preference will be given to candidates with hands-on Gulf culinary experience and expertise in both Arabian cuisine and Arabic bread preparation.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can apply through LinkedIn or share their resume along with details of their culinary specialisation, previous experience and examples of recipes or menus they have developed.

* **We look forward to working with someone who can bring authentic Arabian flavours and professional culinary systems to our growing restaurant business.**

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Foundational AI Research
jobs.description:
Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a
**Flex Work**
approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.
  
  
At Dolby, we are changing the way the world experiences sight and sound. We enable people to experience music, movies, videos, games, and immersive content in their intended grandeur, making life and work more meaningful, expressive, and engaging. We provide technology to the world’s content creators, owners, and distributors, as well as manufacturers of TVs, mobile devices, PCs, and social and media platforms, so they can truly delight their customers. Dolby is behind many of the sound and imaging experiences people enjoy in movie theaters, living rooms, mobile devices, and online services around the world.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
We are building Foundational AI capabilities that advance how people create, understand, enhance, deliver, and experience media. This work spans foundation models, multimodal AI, generative media, content intelligence, media enhancement, personalization, and applied AI systems that can be reused and adapted across Dolby initiatives.
  
  
As Senior Manager, Foundational AI, you will lead the team responsible for defining and delivering Dolby’s Foundational AI strategy across audio, video, imaging, and multimodal experiences. You will set the technical roadmap for reusable AI capabilities, model assets, training and adaptation methods, evaluation frameworks, and reference implementations that help Dolby teams move from research exploration to practical adoption.
  
  
This role requires strong technical leadership in modern AI/ML systems, deep judgment in model strategy, evaluation methodology, and applied AI development, and the ability to connect research advances with practical product and business opportunities. You will work closely with research, product, engineering, platform, legal, privacy, data, and business teams to ensure Dolby’s Foundational AI investments are differentiated, responsibly developed, technically rigorous, and broadly adoptable across the company.
  
  
A major focus of this role is building reusable AI assets and capabilities, including pretrained models, fine-tuning and adaptation recipes, evaluation methodologies, training workflows, model quality benchmarks, and reference implementations. These capabilities will help Dolby teams develop new experiences more efficiently across media understanding, media enhancement, AI-assisted creation, immersive content, personalization, and next-generation entertainment workflows.

* Lead the development of reusable Foundational AI capabilities, including pretrained models, adaptation and fine-tuning recipes, training workflows, evaluation benchmarks, and reference implementations that can be adopted across multiple Dolby teams.
* Set technical direction for model architecture, representation learning, self-supervised learning, generative modeling, multimodal learning, model adaptation, optimization, and evaluation, with attention to quality, robustness, efficiency, scalability, and product relevance.
* Establish model development and evaluation strategies for Foundational AI, including training and validation requirements, data quality expectations, benchmark design, objective metrics, perceptual evaluation, human studies, robustness testing, and product-specific quality gates.
* Partner with product, business group, research, engineering, data, and platform teams to identify high-impact use cases and translate Foundational AI capabilities into practical applications across Dolby products, services, and partner-facing experiences.
* Drive research-to-product transition by moving promising prototypes into validated, reproducible, scalable, and adoptable solutions with clear quality standards, responsible AI practices, and enterprise-ready governance.
* Work closely with platform, MLOps, infrastructure, and data teams to ensure Foundational AI development has the right compute, data pipelines, experiment tracking, artifact management, observability, and deployment paths.
* Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of research scientists while building a culture that balances research creativity, responsible AI practices, and measurable product impact.

**Required Qualifications**
**What You Need to Succeed**

* PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. Advanced degree preferred.
* Proven experience leading and scaling AI/ML teams focused on foundation models, multimodal AI, generative AI, media AI, or applied machine learning systems.
* Strong technical depth in modern AI/ML, including model architecture, representation learning, self-supervised learning, fine-tuning, model adaptation, evaluation, and deployment considerations.
* Experience leading model development across one or more modalities such as audio, speech, music, video, image, text, or multimodal systems.
* Strong understanding of model development workflows, including training and validation data requirements, data quality, evaluation design, governance, privacy, licensing considerations, and continued learning.
* Experience defining evaluation methodologies for complex AI/ML systems, including offline metrics, human evaluation, perceptual quality assessment, robustness testing, and product quality gates.
* Ability to connect research direction with product and business impact, and to prioritize AI investments based on technical feasibility, differentiation, adoption potential, and customer value.
* Experience partnering with platform, MLOps, infrastructure, product, legal, privacy, data, and business stakeholders to move AI/ML capabilities from research into production.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain AI strategy, technical tradeoffs, risks, roadmap decisions, and business implications to technical and executive audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to hire, mentor, and grow senior research talent.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks and ecosystems such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face, Lightning, DeepSpeed, FSDP, or related technologies.
* Experience with foundation model training, fine-tuning, instruction tuning, model compression, distillation, quantization, efficient inference, or large-scale distributed training.
* Experience developing or applying transformer models, diffusion models, autoregressive models, contrastive learning, multimodal representation learning, or generative models.
* Familiarity with production deployment patterns for AI/ML systems, including cloud inference, edge inference, model serving, model monitoring, and continuous improvement loops.

jobs.description:
**Reporting to:**
Director; working closely with Production, R&D, Purchase, Stores, Engineering, Fulfilment and Finance

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Location:**
CC Manufacturing Unit, Bangalore (Onsite)

**Experience:**
6+ years in Quality Assurance / Food Safety, including at least 2 years in a managerial role

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**CTC:**
Up to ₹10 LPA + Benefits

**Role Purpose**

To lead and take overall responsibility for Quality Assurance, Food Safety and Quality Management Systems at CC Pet Foods, ensuring that all manufactured products consistently meet defined quality, nutritional, safety, regulatory and customer requirements.

He/ she will establish and drive a preventive, process-oriented quality culture across raw material sourcing, manufacturing, packaging, storage and dispatch.

The role is accountable for developing robust quality systems, managing the QA team, ensuring regulatory compliance, preventing product failures and driving the company's First Time Right and Zero Compromise on Food Safety philosophy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Management Systems & Regulatory Compliance**

* Own, implement and continuously improve the factory-wide Quality Management System (QMS).
* Develop and enforce SOPs, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), HACCP plans and food safety controls.
* Lead implementation, certification and maintenance of ISO 22000 / FSSC 22000 or equivalent food safety management systems.
* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian regulatory requirements, relevant BIS standards, customer specifications and internal quality policies.
* Establish quality policies, inspection standards, testing protocols and acceptance criteria across manufacturing operations.
* Lead internal, external, customer and certification audits, ensuring timely closure of non-conformities.
* Maintain complete, accurate and audit-ready quality documentation.

**2. Raw Material & Supplier Quality Management**

* Establish quality specifications and acceptance standards for meat, poultry, fish, organs, vegetables, grains, flours, oils, supplements, additives and packaging materials.
* Own incoming material inspection, testing, acceptance, rejection and quarantine procedures.
* Ensure compliance with approved specifications, Certificates of Analysis (COA), temperature requirements and other quality parameters.
* Lead supplier quality qualification, evaluation, audits and performance improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with Purchase and Stores to address supplier quality issues and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure material traceability, proper storage conditions and FIFO/FEFO compliance.
* Develop risk-based inspection and sampling plans for critical raw materials.

**3. Manufacturing Process Quality Assurance**

* Own in-process quality assurance across wet food, baked products and dehydrated treats manufacturing.
* Establish and monitor critical quality parameters and process controls across weighing, mixing, cooking, baking, dehydration, cooling, filling and packaging.
* Ensure manufacturing compliance with approved formulations, process specifications and batch records.
* Monitor and validate critical process parameters including time, temperature, moisture, water activity, product weight and packaging integrity.
* Establish preventive controls against cross-contamination, foreign-body contamination and process deviations.
* Lead investigations into manufacturing non-conformities and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Work with Production and Engineering to improve process capability, reduce rejection and achieve First Time Right production.

**4. Food Safety, Hygiene & Sanitation**

* Take overall responsibility for factory hygiene, sanitation and food safety standards.
* Establish and monitor personnel hygiene, cleaning, sanitation and environmental monitoring programmes.
* Ensure effective hygiene zoning and segregation of raw, semi-processed and finished products.
* Oversee cleaning verification, ATP testing, environmental swabbing and microbiological monitoring.
* Monitor pest control, waste handling, water quality and other environmental conditions affecting food safety.
* Lead food safety risk assessments and ensure timely mitigation of identified hazards.
* Conduct periodic GMP and hygiene audits across production, storage and utility areas.

**5. Finished Product Quality & Batch Release**

* Own finished product quality standards and release procedures.
* Ensure appropriate physical, chemical, microbiological and sensory testing before product release.
* Establish product specifications for nutritional composition, moisture, water activity, packaging integrity, net weight, appearance and shelf life.
* Review batch manufacturing records, process deviations and quality testing results.
* Exercise authority to approve, hold, reject or release finished product batches based on defined quality and food safety criteria.
* Ensure effective management of non-conforming products, retention samples and product stability studies.
* Oversee packaging quality, seal integrity, batch coding, labelling and traceability compliance.

6. Laboratory & Quality Testing Management

* Manage internal quality laboratories and coordinate testing with approved external laboratories.
* Establish testing plans for raw materials, in-process samples, environmental samples and finished products.
* Oversee microbiological, chemical, physical and nutritional quality testing.
* Ensure laboratory equipment calibration, maintenance, method verification and testing accuracy.
* Review laboratory reports, investigate out-of-specification results and approve corrective actions.
* Establish laboratory testing budgets, consumable requirements and equipment procurement plans.
* Work closely with R&D on formulation validation, shelf-life studies and new product development.

**7. Quality Documentation, Traceability & CAPA**

* Establish and maintain robust documentation and record-control systems.
* Ensure end-to-end batch traceability from raw material receipt through manufacturing and dispatch.
* Lead investigations into customer complaints, product defects, contamination risks and quality failures.
* Conduct root cause analysis and ensure effective corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
* Establish product withdrawal and recall procedures and conduct periodic mock recall exercises.
* Maintain quality dashboards, deviation records, audit findings and management review reports.
* Ensure all quality records are complete, accurate and readily available for audits.

**8. Continuous Improvement & Quality Performance**

* Define, monitor and report quality KPIs to senior management.
* Lead initiatives to reduce rejection, rework, process losses, customer complaints and cost of poor quality.
* Identify recurring process deviations and implement preventive improvements.
* Participate in equipment commissioning, process validation, new product trials and manufacturing scale-up.
* Collaborate with Production, R&D, Engineering and Procurement to improve product consistency and manufacturing efficiency.
* Promote data-driven quality decisions and continuous improvement across departments.

**9. QA Team Leadership & Department Management**

* Lead, mentor and develop the Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Define department structure, responsibilities, manpower requirements and shift coverage.
* Set performance objectives, review team performance and develop technical capabilities.
* Establish training programmes covering GMP, HACCP, hygiene, quality inspection, documentation and food safety.
* Manage the QA department budget, laboratory expenses and quality-related resources.
* Build a culture of accountability, integrity, disciplined execution and continuous improvement.
* Ensure independent and objective quality decisions, including escalation of critical food safety risks to management.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
  
  
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
  
  
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
  
  
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.
* Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.
* Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.
* Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.
* Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.
* Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.
* Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.
* Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

**What You Will Need**

* Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)
* Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking
* Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

jobs.title: Food Quality Analyst — Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO)
jobs.description:
**About the School of Environment and Sustainability (SES)**

The IIHS Long-Term Urban Ecological Observatory (LTUEO) at the Kengeri campus is an important part of the SES and integrates state of the art observation and measurement systems for biodiversity, air, water and soil, food and ecosystem services to serve the needs of sustainable management of the campus and function as a research and educational resource for the larger community.

The Food Safety Testing Lab is a part of the LTUEO and Sustainable Urban Agriculture initiative at the IIHS Kengeri campus, within the SES.

**Job Description**

IIHS seeks a meticulous and technically skilled food quality analyst/ technician to support the Food Safety Testing Lab in understanding and communicating the changing chemical and microbiological variables of food (both cooked and uncooked) on campus and in the neighboring lake, forest, and urban ecosystems.

The role will be responsible for conducting qualitative and quantitative tests to determine the physical and chemical properties of food, recording and compiling the test results, preparing charts and reports, as well as preparing and incubating plates with cultures. It will also involve defining quality assurance targets and procedures and ensuring their maintenance and continued improvement by reviewing targets, protocols, supplies, processes, equipment, and technologies for quality standards.

The candidate will be expected to spend substantial time at the IIHS Kengeri Campus and provide support as needed, on other IIHS projects under the SES.

This is a contractual engagement for an initial term of 11 months, renewable on mutual

consent and based on performance, and with the potential to turn into a regular position over time.

Responsibilities would include, but not be limited to, the following:

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer (Pre-Sales) – Food Supply Chain Traceability
jobs.description:
**Bengaluru · Hybrid · 2–5 years**

Help India's food and agri companies, from FMCG majors to seafood and meat exporters, trace every unit from farm and factory to shelf. As our first-line technical expert in sales, you'll turn the real-world complexity of factories and warehouses into traceability solutions that executives buy and operators actually use.

**About Tralexho**

Tralexho is a patented Traceability-as-a-Service (TaaS) platform for the food and agri supply chain, from raw material and processing to warehousing, distribution and the end consumer. Customers use us to cut losses and counterfeits, recall with precision, and comply from day one with GS1, HACCP, USFDA FSMA 204, EUDR and other standards.

We won the
**MoFPI National Award 2025 for Food Safety & Traceability**
, were shortlisted in
**APEDA's Business Challenge 2026 for export-enabling technology**
, and were named to
**Forbes India DGEMS Select 200**
. We co-authored the
**BIS traceability standard for India**
, are part of NVIDIA Inception, and run AI traceability research with ICAR-CIFT and KUFOS.
*Designed in India, designed for the world.*

**The role**

You'll join the revenue team, reporting to the Head of Sales, and own the technical side of every deal: discovery, demo, proof-of-concept and handover to implementation. You'll work with Indian enterprises serving the domestic market and with exporters selling into the US, EU and beyond.

**What you'll do**

* Run technical discovery with plant heads, quality and supply-chain leaders, and IT, and map the customer's current flows of material, data and systems
* Deliver demos tailored to the customer's own products, lines and warehouses
* Design and run PoCs with product and engineering: scope them, set success criteria, deploy and present the results
* Specify and configure sensors and scanners (barcode/QR, RFID, environmental sensors) for PoCs and deployments, and work with hardware partners on the shop floor
* Answer integration, data and security questions (ERP/WMS, APIs, device connectivity) and compliance questions (FSMA 204, EUDR, GS1, HACCP)
* Write solution proposals and RFP/RFI responses, using AI tools to move fast without cutting corners
* Bring field insight back to product so it shapes what we build next

**Your first 90 days**

* **30 days:**
  Know the platform and our standard hardware set well enough to demo it end to end, and shadow live customer engagements
* **60 days:**
  Run discovery and demos on your own
* **90 days:**
  Lead a PoC, including on-site device setup, from scoping to customer sign-off

**Must-haves**

* 2–5 years (career breaks included) in B2B SaaS pre-sales, solutions engineering or technical consulting
* A solid grasp of SaaS architecture, APIs and data integration
* Comfort explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical buyers, and clear writing for proposals and RFPs

**Nice-to-haves**

* Supply chain, manufacturing, FMCG, seafood, meat or agri-export exposure
* GS1 standards, serialization, packaging aggregation or EPCIS
* SAP or other ERP/WMS integration experience
* Hands-on experience with scanners, sensors or other connected devices in a production or field setting
* Hindi, Kannada or another regional language for plant-floor conversations

**How we work**

We work hybrid. Most work is remote, and we meet in person 4–8 days a month (usually 1–2 days a week) at our Bengaluru HQ in Whitefield, or at customer sites. You'll need to live within commuting distance of Whitefield. Site visits are part of the role: typically once a month to customer plants, warehouses and processing centres, mostly day trips around Bengaluru during working hours. Some sites are meat and seafood processing facilities. Occasional outstation trips are planned in advance, travel and stay are arranged and paid by us, and your first visits are with a teammate.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay plus variable pay tied to revenue
* Real ownership in a small, award-winning team working on food safety at national and global scale

**Hiring process**

A 30-minute intro call → a technical conversation → a mock discovery and demo with our team → a conversation with our founders.

**How to apply**

Click the Apply link to go to our short application form. It takes about 10 minutes: your CV, a few practical details, and two brief questions in your own words. We'd rather explore your experience properly in conversation than ask you to write essays, and we appreciate your interest.

jobs.title: Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer
jobs.description:
**We’re hiring |**
Experienced
**Contract Manufacturing & Quality Assurance Officer**

**Knoxx Foods Australia · Bengaluru (Bangalore)**

This role is based in Bengaluru and requires frequent travel to partner factories across India and willingness to travel overseas when required.

Knoxx Foods develops ingredients and meal components for Australian food manufacturers, including shelf-stable rice and pulses, dry blends and coatings. We’re looking for someone who has managed production at third-party food factories and can represent Knoxx on the factory floor. You’ll oversee how our products are made, how our formulations are protected and whether each order leaves the factory on time and in full.

**What you’ll do**

* **Manage production at partner factories.**
  Agree schedules for trials and commercial runs, confirm raw material and line availability, and track output and yields. When a run falls behind, agree a recovery plan with the factory and follow it through.
* **Verify product and process quality.**
  Conduct frequent site audits to assess facilities, testing capabilities and production practices. Observe live runs to verify that operators follow approved standard operating procedures (SOPs). Check batch records, traceability and test results against Knoxx specifications, then verify that corrective actions work.
* **Protect Knoxx’s intellectual property.**
  Before sharing formulations, process instructions or customer specifications, verify that each factory has confidentiality and access controls in place. During audits, check who can access the information, how printed and electronic copies are controlled, and whether obsolete versions have been withdrawn. Escalate suspected breaches and follow corrective actions through to closure.
* **Plan packaging ahead of every run.**
  Work backwards from the dispatch date to determine when approved pouches, labels and cartons must reach the factory. Confirm quantities, stock and supplier lead times, then track orders through receipt so shortages can be resolved before packing begins.
* **Optimise packaging.**
  Trial pouch sizes, carton configurations and pallet layouts with factories, suppliers and Knoxx R&D. Assess product protection, packing-line performance, waste, cost and container utilisation before recommending changes.
* **Ensure timely factory dispatch.**
  Confirm finished quantities, labels, packing lists, QA release status and freight collection against the committed date. Track each order until it leaves the facility and alert our Australian operations team early enough to act on any shipment risk.

**What you’ll bring**

At least 3 or more years hands-on experience managing production at third-party food manufacturers or co-packers is
**essential**
. You should also have practical experience auditing food factories, checking compliance with SOPs, handling confidential technical information, planning packaging and coordinating dispatch. A qualification in food technology, food science, food processing or a related discipline is a
**must**
.

**What you’ll get**

* Attractive Salary
* Company laptop and phone
* Reimbursement of interstate and overseas expenses.

**To apply**
, send me your CV by LinkedIn message with your current location, earliest firm joining date and
**confirmation that you’re available for domestic and overseas travel as described**
.

jobs.title: Industry Technology Specialist - Technical Service: Distilling and Biofuel
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guiding purpose. It is how we have made an impact, and it is how we will continue to make a difference.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As an Industry Technology Specialist for Distilling & Biofuel, you will join our Technical Service team within Planetary Health Biosolutions.
  
  
Working closely with our Grain Processing team, you will provide technical support to customers in the grain-based ethanol and biofuel industries. You will design and execute plant trials, troubleshoot complex production challenges, and help customers optimize fermentation and ethanol production processes.
  
  
Through your technical expertise, analytical approach, and cross-functional collaboration, you will turn scientific and process insights into practical solutions that support customer success and business development.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Provide high-quality technical service to grain-based distilleries and ethanol-producing plants across India.
* Design, coordinate, and execute plant trials and experiments related to grain processing, fermentation, and ethanol production.
* Analyze trial and production data, draw clear conclusions, and communicate findings to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Support customers in optimizing grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Recommend suitable yeast strains and support yeast propagation, viability, vitality, and performance management.
* Troubleshoot stuck or sluggish fermentations, contamination, low yeast viability, process deviations, and reduced ethanol yields.
* Optimize process parameters such as temperature, pH, nutrient levels, and enzyme dosage to improve production efficiency.
* Conduct root cause analyses using production data, trends, and relevant statistical methods.
* Support the improvement of sterilization and Clean-in-Place processes to help customers prevent and control contamination.
* Build strong working relationships with customers and collaborate with commercial, application, laboratory, and other cross-functional teams.
* Share technical knowledge and train customer teams to help prevent recurring production challenges.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A bachelor’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* Between 5 and 10 years of relevant professional experience in a grain-based distillery, ethanol plant, or biofuel production environment.
* Practical knowledge of grain-based ethanol production processes.
* Experience working with grains such as rice, corn, sorghum, or wheat.
* Technical knowledge of grain milling, liquefaction, saccharification, fermentation, distillation, and DDGS processes.
* Experience selecting and managing yeast strains for ethanol production.
* Knowledge of yeast propagation and the management of yeast viability and vitality.
* Experience troubleshooting fermentation issues, including contamination, low yeast viability, sluggish or stuck fermentation, and reduced ethanol yield.
* The ability to analyze production and trial data using Microsoft Excel or another relevant data-analysis tool.
* The ability to plan and lead plant trials and clearly communicate findings and recommendations.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively across India to support ethanol-producing plants.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* A master’s degree in Biotechnology, Food Technology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Chemical Engineering, Bioprocessing, or a related discipline.
* A strong understanding of yeast metabolism and its role in converting sugars into ethanol.
* Experience using statistical tools and data trends to investigate production deviations.
* Experience improving sterilization and Clean-in-Place protocols in an industrial production environment.
* A collaborative approach to solving technical challenges and sharing knowledge with customers and colleagues.
* The ability to work proactively, take responsibility, and translate new ideas into practical solutions.

**What We Offer You**
You will join a collaborative and scientifically driven environment where innovation, curiosity, and technical expertise are valued.
  
  
You will have the opportunity to work closely with customers, technical specialists, laboratory colleagues, and commercial teams while contributing to the advancement of biological solutions for the distilling and biofuel industries.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to apply your expertise to complex industrial challenges, develop new knowledge, and contribute to solutions that improve process performance and the use of our planet’s resources.
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
  
  
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.
  
  
We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.
  
  
**Position Summary**
This role offers you the chance to lead statistical activities within our global Manufacturing Science and Technology (MSAT) team. You will work closely with teams across functions and countries to apply your statistical expertise to improve manufacturing processes, support product development, and ensure high-quality supply. We value collaborative problem solvers who communicate clearly and take ownership with care. Join us to grow your career while making a real impact on patient outcomes by helping bring medicines to life faster and better. At GSK, we unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together, and this is your opportunity to be part of that mission.
  
  
***Job Purpose:***
Work with global multidisciplinary teams to accelerate statistically driven process understanding and problem solving in Global Supply Chain by driving business results with data-based insights and robust statistical methodologies.
  
  

* As a Subject Matter Expert in Statistics, help drive the statistically driven capability of GSC (Global Supply Chain) across all sites and functions, identifying and exploring opportunities for product and process optimisation and guiding the appropriate interpretation of statistical evidence for decisions.
* Elaborate and communicate sophisticated statistical concepts, displaying information visually and making the patterns and insights revealed in data clear and compelling; communicate concepts and results in a way that is understandable to stakeholders and demonstrate storytelling with data, both verbally and visually.
* Manage and influence internal global networks to adopt rigorous and sound statistical approaches and standardise methodologies globally. Work Model This is an on-site role based in India. We offer a supportive environment where inclusion is valued, and your unique perspective is welcomed. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work and grow both professionally and personally.

**Responsibility :**

* Act as an essential partner within cross-functional global teams by providing statistical expertise to help interpret statistical outputs and use these alongside other scientific understanding to drive outcomes aligned to GSK values, particularly for deviations, investigations and improvement projects.
* Lead the statistical analysis, reporting and communication of results and conclusions in the form of technical documents and presentations in accordance with regulatory and internal guidance, taking full ownership and accountability of all statistical content.
* Design and lead appropriate statistical studies, including study design and sample size calculations, process and method validation, assay or process trending, assay or process transfers and similar applications relevant to MSAT and global manufacturing operations.
* Ensure high-quality statistical evaluation and reporting, e.g. for regulatory dossiers, ensuring compliance with internal and external requirements (e.g. GSK QMS, GSK SOPs, Ph.Eur., ICH/FDA guidelines) and ensuring integrity, traceability and reproducibility of statistical evaluations.
* Influence GSK internal policies, guidelines and SOPs to ensure appropriate statistical application and data evaluation in manufacturing, MSAT and quality systems.
* Actively participate in, and when required lead, the wider statistics and data science network (MSAT, Quality, TRD and R&D, as well as the GPS (GSK Production System) community) to develop, align and standardise data evaluation methods, methodologies and conventions, ensuring that best practices are incorporated into local ways of working at GCC.
* Upskill the organisation through coaching, mentoring and training of non-statisticians and junior statisticians and data scientists on the appropriate application of statistics and data evaluation tools for their business processes.
* Contribute statistical expertise to MSAT activities including process optimisation and troubleshooting, investigations and technology development, process validation, continuous improvement, technical support, regulatory compliance, data analysis and reporting, training and audit readiness for global site operations.
* Masters degree or PhD in statistics, mathematics, data science, computer science, or related field, with a strong focus on Statistics.
* Provides a comprehensive understanding of statistical theory required for the application and leadership of appropriate methodologies in a complex manufacturing and MSAT environment.

**How to Apply :**
If this opportunity excites you, please apply now. Share your experience and any adjustments you may need during the recruitment process. We look forward to learning how you can help us get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Skills**
Analytical Thinking, Bioinformatic Analysis, Computational Biology, Data Analysis Tools, Data Storytelling, Data Visualization, Drug Discovery Process, Genomics, Influencing Without Authority, Life Science, Machine Learning (ML), Scientific Research, Statistics
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.
  
  
**Inclusion at GSK:**
As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.
  
  
Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Description**
Do you enjoy designing and implementing solutions to ambiguous and complex problems? Are you looking to expand your scope of impact and influence strategic decision making? Are you in the market for a new, exciting challenge where you are empowered to use your ingenuity to innovate? If so, we are looking for talented people like you to join our Regulatory, Intelligence, Safety and Compliance (RISC) solution delivery team.
  
  
The RISC team's charter is to protect Amazon customers from products that are illegal, illegally marketed, unsafe, or otherwise prohibited by Amazon policies. In this role, you will work closely with legal, business teams, selling partner experience and support teams, operational excellence, product, BI and data science/engineering teams to deliver high-impact end-to-end safety and compliance solutions. Think of this role as a non-technical "solution architect" where you will be given autonomy to develop a strategy and build effective policy enforcements to ensure product safety and compliance worldwide.
  
  
The Senior Risk Manager drives the development and implementation of new tools and programs that advance the store's global safety and compliance efforts. This role requires influencing cross-functional stakeholders, planning strategic projects with legal and business partners, securing team commitments, and developing daily, weekly, and monthly metrics while ensuring compliance with Amazon quality standards and regulatory program expectations.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cross-Functional Programs: Own and deliver complex, cross-cutting initiatives by partnering with legal, business, tech, and operational excellence teams—bringing structure and momentum to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder efforts.
* Influence Without Authority: Build trusted relationships across multiple organizations; align diverse stakeholders around shared goals, secure commitments, and drive decisions forward—even when you don't own the teams doing the work.
* Build the Mechanisms That Keep Us Sharp: Design and run the operating cadences (business reviews, launch readiness checkpoints, intake processes) that ensure our safety and compliance controls launch with quality and consistency every time.
* Own the Metrics That Matter: Define, develop, and maintain the daily, weekly, and monthly performance metrics that give the team and leadership clear visibility into what's working, what's not, and where to focus next.
* Find the Friction and Fix It: Identify bottlenecks, eliminate redundant work, and drive automation opportunities that free up risk managers to focus on the high-judgment, high-impact work they do best.
* Raise the Quality Bar: Establish and maintain standards for control launches and program deliverables, ensuring every enforcement we ship meets Amazon's quality expectations and regulatory requirements.
* Turn Strategy into Action: Partner with leadership to translate business priorities and legal requirements into clear project plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines that teams can actually execute against.
* Build Tools and Frameworks That Scale: Champion the development of new tools, templates, and repeatable playbooks that accelerate the team's ability to launch safety and compliance programs worldwide.
* Write with Clarity and Purpose: Author crisp, well-structured documents—SOPs, program updates, leadership narratives—that make complex information accessible and drive informed decision-making.
* Be the Operational Backbone: Keep the trains running. Maintain visibility across workstreams, remove blockers, track commitments, and create the organizational structure that makes everyone on the team more effective at their jobs.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience managing multiple competing priorities simultaneously and driving goals to completion
* 5+ years of program or project Management experience
* Experience building cross-functional partnerships and influencing stakeholders across the organization to act without having a direct reporting relationship
* Experience developing and implementing of standards, policies and programs or equivalent

* Experience leveraging technology and implementing lean principles / Six Sigma methodologies to drive process improvements or equivalent

**Role Summary:**

The Assistant Registrar – Legal & Compliance will support the Registrar and University leadership in managing legal, regulatory, statutory and governance-related matters of the University. The role will be responsible for monitoring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, University statutes, ordinances and regulatory requirements; supporting the drafting and review of legal and institutional documents; coordinating with external legal counsel and regulatory authorities; and ensuring proper documentation and timely follow-up on legal and compliance matters.

The position will also support the University's statutory bodies, policy development, risk mitigation, and legal aspects of matters relating to students, faculty, staff, contracts, institutional assets and other administrative functions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Legal Affairs & Advisory:**

* Provide legal support and assistance to the Registrar and University leadership on institutional, academic, employment, contractual and administrative matters.
* Draft, review and vet agreements, MoUs, contracts, service agreements, NDAs, undertakings, notices and other legal documents.
* Review legal implications of proposed institutional initiatives, partnerships, contracts and administrative decisions and provide appropriate inputs.
* Coordinate responses to legal notices, claims, disputes and litigation in consultation with the Registrar and external legal counsel.
* Maintain an organised repository of legal documents, agreements, notices, case records and related correspondence.
* Maintain a comprehensive register of agreements/MoUs and monitor their validity, renewal and key contractual obligations.

**Regulatory & Statutory Compliance:**

* Monitor compliance with the applicable University Act, Statutes, Ordinances, UGC Regulations, AICTE requirements, State higher education laws and other applicable statutory/regulatory requirements.
* Track changes in education, employment, labour, data protection and other relevant laws and communicate their implications to concerned stakeholders.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of statutory returns, reports, declarations and other regulatory filings within prescribed timelines.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and follow up with concerned departments/schools for timely fulfilment of statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Support the University during regulatory inspections, audits, accreditation processes and other statutory reviews from a legal and compliance perspective.
* Assist in identifying gaps in compliance and coordinate appropriate corrective and preventive actions.

**University Governance :**

* Support the functioning of statutory and governance bodies of the University, including the Board of Governors, Academic Council and other committees, as assigned.
* Assist in preparing legal notes, background documents and compliance inputs for meetings of statutory bodies.
* Support the Registrar's Office in ensuring proper documentation, follow-up and implementation of decisions/resolutions of statutory bodies.
* Assist in reviewing University policies, rules, regulations and procedures to ensure consistency with applicable laws and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain appropriate records relating to statutory approvals, resolutions, legal opinions and governance-related matters.

**Student, Faculty & Staff Related Legal Matters:**

* Provide legal and compliance support in matters relating to student discipline, grievances, academic integrity and other student-related issues.
* Support HR in matters relating to employment contracts, service rules, disciplinary proceedings and applicable labour/employment laws.
* Assist in reviewing service agreements, consultancy arrangements and other employment-related documentation.
* Support the handling of information disclosure, RTI-related matters, data privacy and other confidentiality-related requirements, as applicable.
* Ensure that appropriate legal and procedural safeguards are considered while dealing with sensitive institutional matters.

**Risk Management & Coordination:**

* Identify potential legal and regulatory risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Support the development and implementation of compliance mechanisms, checklists and standard operating procedures.
* Liaise with external lawyers, legal consultants, government departments, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal departments for resolution of legal and compliance issues and ensure timely closure of identified matters.
* Support internal audits, reviews and investigations relating to legal, regulatory and compliance matters.
* Maintain appropriate records and reports on the status of legal, regulatory and compliance matters.

**General Responsibilities:**

* Ensure confidentiality and appropriate handling of sensitive legal, institutional and personal information.
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, documentation and professional integrity in all legal and compliance-related work.
* Perform any other duties and responsibilities assigned by the Registrar from time to time.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

**Educational Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognised university/institution.
* LL.M. or an additional qualification in Corporate Law, Education Law, Compliance or a related area will be an advantage.
* Enrolment with the Bar Council is preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 5–8 years of relevant post-qualification experience in legal, regulatory, compliance or university administration roles.
* Experience in a higher education institution, university, educational trust, statutory body or large organisation with significant regulatory exposure will be preferred.
* Experience in drafting and reviewing contracts, MoUs and other legal documents is essential.
* Experience in handling legal notices, disputes and coordination with external legal counsel is desirable.
* Experience in dealing with UGC, AICTE, State higher education authorities or other regulatory/statutory bodies will be an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies:**

* Ability to interpret legal and regulatory provisions and translate them into clear, practical guidance.

jobs.description:
Introduction
  
  
**Functional Consultant - Financial Crime Compliance & Screening**
**Position Title**
Functional Consultant - Financial Crime Compliance & Screening
  
  
**Department**
Professional Services - Financial Crime Compliance
  
  
**Reports To**
Head of Professional Services EMEA
  
  
**Experience Level**
8+ years
  
  
**Location**
Hybrid / based on engagement requirements (EMEA preferred, travel as needed)
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Purpose**
SymphonyAI is seeking a Functional Consultant specialising in sanctions, PEP and adverse media screening, transaction monitoring, and broader financial crime compliance. This is a dual-mandate role: trusted advisor to financial institutions on regulatory obligations, risk appetite, and operating model — and hands-on practitioner who personally configures, tunes, and optimises SymphonyAI solutions on live project engagements.
  
  
This is not an advisory-only position. A significant portion of time is spent in the product: calibrating thresholds, optimising matching logic, and reducing false positives — alongside leading workshops, shaping solution designs, and challenging client thinking with an AI-first mindset.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Hands-On Configuration, Tuning & Optimisation**

* Personally configure, tune, and optimise SymphonyAI screening and financial crime solutions on client projects: threshold calibration, matching logic, segmentation, list management, and false-positive reduction.
* Design and run testing and validation exercises that demonstrably improve detection quality and operational efficiency; analyse system performance and alert outcomes to drive improvements.
* Deliver implementation workstreams end to end: process design, configuration, controls testing, and user training.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to feed field insight into product innovation.

**Client Advisory & Consulting**

* Run workshops and discovery sessions to gather requirements, define use cases, and align solutions to client priorities, risk appetite, and regulatory obligations.
* Translate requirements into functional solution designs, workflows, and implementation recommendations; conduct gap analyses and remediation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor across client Compliance, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams — challenging existing methodologies to drive better outcomes.
* Advise customers on applying predictive AI, generative AI, and automation to improve screening accuracy, reduce false positives, and lift investigator productivity.

**Practice Development**

* Contribute to the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence: tuning methodologies, playbooks, and accelerators.
* Produce high-quality functional documentation, tuning reports, and implementation guidance; mentor junior consultants.

**Requirements**
**Must-Have**

* Demonstrable hands-on experience configuring, tuning, calibrating, and optimising financial crime or screening solutions — candidates must evidence tuning work personally executed, not overseen.
* 8+ years in financial crime compliance, sanctions, AML/KYC, or screening — in financial institutions, RegTech vendors, or professional services.
* Deep knowledge of end-to-end financial crime processes (onboarding, KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, screening, monitoring, investigations, SAR/STR) and of typologies, evasion techniques, and detection methodologies.
* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory frameworks (e.g. FATF, FCA, FinCEN, EU AMLD/AMLR, CBUAE) and of screening data providers such as World-Check (LSEG) and Dow Jones.
* Strong consulting presence: proven experience running workshops and engaging senior compliance, risk, operations, and technology stakeholders up to C-suite; excellent communication and facilitation skills.
* Proficiency with SQL and data analysis for tuning and compliance insight (e.g. Power BI, Alteryx, or equivalent).

**Preferred**

* Experience with screening/monitoring platforms such as SymphonyAI NetReveal, Fircosoft, SAS, or equivalent; exposure to AI-enabled compliance technologies.
* Professional certifications: CAMS, CAMI, or ICA/MOET AML/CFT.
* Cloud SaaS implementation experience; exposure to transaction monitoring model tuning or fraud detection.
* Background in RegTech, Big 4 / specialised compliance consulting, or financial crime transformation programmes.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Delivery: on-time, on-scope, on-budget engagements; billable utilisation ≥ 80%.
* Tuning outcomes: measurable improvements in detection effectiveness and false-positive reduction.
* Client satisfaction: > 90% satisfaction; positive feedback on both advisory expertise and hands-on delivery.
* Practice & quality: contribution to CoE methodologies and playbooks; adherence to SymphonyAI delivery standards.

**Reporting Line**

* Reports to: Head of Professional Services EMEA
* Collaborates with: Product, Engineering, Data Science, Delivery Operations, Sales, and offshore delivery partners. May lead junior consultants on projects.

**About Us**
**What SymphonyAI Offers**

* Tier-1 global financial institutions, transformational screening programmes, and genuine hands-on ownership of tuning outcomes on a market-leading AI SaaS platform.
* A role in building the Financial Crime Compliance Centre of Excellence, with global exposure across EMEA, Americas, and APAC, hybrid flexibility, and competitive compensation.

jobs.description:
**About The Job Senior Product Manager, Bengaluru**
Role: Senior Product Manager, Bengaluru
  
  
Experience: 10+ years
  
  
Salary: upto 15-20 LPA
  
  
Note: Experience in the service or social sector, ideally in livelihoods, financial inclusion, MSME, or rural development.
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**About The Role**
Our livelihoods program works with nano-entrepreneurs—small shop owners, street vendors, home-based producers, and a growing number of rural nano-entrepreneurs, many of them women. They run on thin margins, with patchy networks and limited digital literacy, and rarely operate in English.
  
  
Field operatives, Monitoring & Evaluation (M&E), and program and operations teams all need technology, and today those needs reach the tech team as separate requests. We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to set the product vision and turn these needs into one unified roadmap, grounded in time spent in the field. This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Technology.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**Vision and Strategy**

* Set a 2–3 year product vision for how technology and AI can help our livelihoods program reach more nano-entrepreneurs and make field operatives more effective.
* Own the product roadmap, combining field, M&E, and operational requirements.
* Prioritize with evidence (impact on nano-entrepreneurs, effort, cost, risk) and be clear about what we won't build.
* Identify where AI meaningfully helps, and where it doesn't.

**Field Discovery**

* Spend about 20% of your time with field operatives and nano-entrepreneurs in rural and urban locations.
* Run user research and quick prototypes with low-literacy, multilingual users.

**Delivery and Outcomes**

* Write requirements engineers can build from; make scope, sequencing, and build-or-buy calls with them.
* Plan pilots and rollouts with field teams, designing for multiple languages, voice, and low-end Android devices.
* Define success metrics, track adoption and outcomes, and work with M&E on impact measurement.
* Ensure products respect privacy and consent, including India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.

**Stakeholders**

* Bridge program, field, M&E, operations, fundraising, and technology teams, and communicate the roadmap to leadership, funders, and partners.

**Skills and Experience**
**Essential**

* 8–10 years of overall experience, with at least 2–3 years in product management owning a product from discovery to launch.
* Bachelor's degree; an MBA or Master's is a plus.
* Experience in the service or social sector, ideally in livelihoods, financial inclusion, MSME, or rural development.
* Strategic thinking: able to set a product vision and connect it to organizational goals.
* Enough technical depth to build a technology roadmap and hold your own with engineers on APIs, data, mobile, web, and cloud.
* Working knowledge of AI and LLM-based products, including evaluation and cost.
* Data-driven: comfortable with metrics, dashboards, and basic SQL or analytics tools.
* Speaks and works in at least one of Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, or Marathi, along with English, with empathy for multilingual and voice-first users.
* Able to travel about 20% of the time.
* Clear communicator who partners well with field teams, engineers, leadership, and funders.

**Nice to Have**

* Built for low-bandwidth, offline-first, or low-end Android contexts in India.
* Experience with WhatsApp, chatbot, or voice interfaces, or field data tools like KoboToolbox or ODK.
* Worked with M&E teams, or on DPDP and privacy-by-design.

**Mindsets We're Looking For**

* A real pull towards livelihoods and social impact.
* Field-first, comfortable with ambiguity, and honest about where technology doesn't help.
* Low ego, high ownership.

**Hiring Note**
: Applications will be reviewed on rolling basis. This job is first posted on Nov 12, 2026 on Ground Zero
  
  
For any questions, ping us on WhatsApp chat: +91-8058331557

jobs.description:
**Job Title:**
Product Engineer, Gaming

**Location:**
Bangalore, India (Full-Time In-Office)

**About:**

We are dedicated to creating unique and exceptional gaming experiences. Our studio is a place where
**data-driven strategy meets deep engineering ownership**
, and where engineers don’t just build features , they shape product outcomes.

We are looking for
**high-IQ, product-minded engineers**
who can think from first principles, move fast, and take end-to-end ownership of systems that directly impact player experience, retention, and monetization.

**The Role:**

You’ll be the person who
**collapses the gap between idea and evidence**
.

From the first whiteboard discussion to the first playtest to the first feature shipped, you own that arc end-to-end. You’ll work closely with Product, Design, Art and Engineering to turn
**hypotheses → prototypes → production systems**
.

This is not a pure coding role. It’s not a pure product role.

It’s for someone who is operates credibly in both

**What You'll Do:**

* **Ideation & Concept Testing**
  : Rapidly prototype game ideas in days, define clear hypotheses, instrument for signal, and decide fast—iterate or kill.
* **Prototyping & 0→1 Ownership**
  : Own prototype lifecycle end-to-end (scope → build → playtest → decision) with a focus on speed and learning.
* **Feature Development & System Ownership**
  : Take validated ideas to production, ensuring clean execution, minimal drift, and strong launch readiness.
* **Core Game Systems**
  : Build scalable, config-driven systems (progression, economy, live ops, FTUE) optimized for fast iteration.
* **Experimentation & Data**
  : Ship features with instrumentation, run experiments, and iterate based on real player behavior and metrics.
* **Product Thinking**
  : Evaluate what to build (and what not to) using data, player insight, and first-principles thinking.

**What You'll Bring:**

***Must-Haves:***

* Strong engineering background (CS fundamentals, system design, debugging); ability to quickly pick up new tools and technologies
* Strong product instincts, you’ve built or shipped something and
  **learned from its success/failure**
* High IQ with the ability to address significant problems from first principles and in a well-structured way.
* Massive attention to detail, ensuring you don’t miss any minor issues.
* Outstanding communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.

***Nice-to-Haves:***

* Experience in mobile F2P product roles; shipped or operated a live-service title.
* Proven track record of taking a prototype → live feature within a professional games studio environment.
* Hands-on A/B testing, UA creative iteration, and basic ad monetization mechanics.
* Experience with game engines like Unity or similar interactive systems

**Why You'll Love It Here:**

* **Impact:**
  You will have a direct and measurable impact on our very ambitious game, shaping its visual identity and commercial success.
* **Ownership:**
  You will be given the autonomy and resources to build and lead a high-performance creative product vertical.
* **Innovation:**
  You will be at the forefront of the industry, empowered to explore and implement cutting-edge technologies like AI.
* **Culture:**
  You will join a passionate, collaborative, and data-informed team that values both creative excellence and business results.
* **Benefits:**
  We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package, and a work environment that strongly supports your professional growth.
