jobs.title: FirstClub - Senior Product Manager - Supply Chain Domain
jobs.description:
**About FirstClub**
At FirstClub, we are building a new kind of quick commerce from the ground up, and the supply chain is where that promise is won or lost.
  
  
The Supply Chain Product team builds the systems that decide what we buy, where it sits, how it moves and what we promise each member.
  
  
Every order that reaches a member on time, fresh and complete is the output of our products.
  
  
**The Team's Charter Spans The Full Supply Chain**

* Buying & Sourcing : demand-led purchase planning, vendor management, PO lifecycle and inbound scheduling.
* Collection Centers : first-mile intake, quality checks, grading and consolidation of fresh and farm produce.
* Distribution Centers (DCs) : inbound, putaway, storage, picking, packing, outbound and returns.
* Middle Mile : DC-to-Club House replenishment, trip planning, vehicle utilization and inventory movement.
* Club Houses : receiving, storage, pick-pack, cycle counts, freshness and wastage control.
* Inventory Management : single source of truth for stock, ageing and expiry, replenishment and inventory accuracy across nodes.
* Capacity Management : labor, slot, storage and throughput planning across nodes and time of day.
* Promise Engine : what we promise each member - availability and delivery ETA - based on live inventory and capacity.

**Why FirstClub**

* Build, don't babysit : Much of our supply chain stack is being built right now. You will design core systems, not just tune someone else's.
* Small team, big surface area : You'll own outcomes that would sit with a whole team at a larger company.
* Fast loops : Ship on Monday, watch it run on a Club House floor by Wednesday, improve it by Friday.
* Ground truth over slide decks : Our PMs spend real time in DCs, Collection Centers and Club Houses, not just in dashboards.
* Scrappy beats perfect : We'd rather run a pilot this week than polish a plan for next quarter.
* Your fingerprints on the company : The decisions you make now shape how FirstClub scales to every new city.

**The Role**
As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the end-to-end supply chain product charter at FirstClub - from how we source and buy, through Collection Centers, DCs and the middle mile, to inventory in our Club Houses and the promise we make each member.
  
  
Your mandate is to build a high-control, intelligent and scalable supply chain that improves availability, freshness and speed while driving down cost per order and wastage.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own the product vision, strategy and roadmap across Buying & Sourcing, Collection Centers, DCs, Middle Mile, Club Houses, Inventory Management, Capacity Management and the Promise Engine.
* Set and own the north-star metrics for the charter : availability and fill rate, promise adherence, inventory accuracy, days of inventory, wastage and shrinkage, cost per order and throughput per node.
* Partner deeply with Supply Chain, Category, Operations and Finance leadership to find the biggest ground-level problems and convert them into a prioritised, outcome-driven roadmap.
* Architect the core systems with Engineering : a single source of truth for inventory across nodes, a demand-led buying and replenishment engine, and a Promise Engine that balances availability, capacity and speed in real time.
* Build capacity planning across labour, slots, storage and vehicles, so the network flexes for peaks, new categories and new cities.
* Own the frontline tooling strategy for associates, site managers, QC teams and transport partners - making work simpler, faster and measurable, including productivity tracking and incentives.
* Lead build-vs-buy decisions across WMS, TMS, procurement and planning systems, and drive integrations with vendors and 3P partners.
* Treat AI and automation as first principles, not add-ons : forecasting, auto-replenishment, intelligent allocation, anomaly and shrinkage detection, and agentic workflows that remove manual decisions from planners and site teams.
* Run a strong experimentation and measurement culture - pilots by node or city, clear success criteria, and rigorous readouts.
* Lead, coach and grow a team of Product Managers, raising the bar on problem framing, execution, stakeholder management and ground-level empathy.
* Help shape the operating model for scaling FirstClub's supply chain across cities with high reliability and healthy unit economics.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5 - 8 years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning and scaling products with measurable business impact.
* Experience leading or mentoring Product Managers, and happy to be a player-coach who still owns hands-on product work.
* Deep experience in supply chain, warehousing, quick commerce, e-commerce, grocery, food delivery or logistics, ideally across more than one node of the chain.
* Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, warehouse operations, middle-mile logistics, capacity planning or delivery promise systems.
* Experience building products with a significant frontline or ground operations component.
* Proven ability to move operational and financial metrics such as fill rate, wastage, cost per order, productivity and SLA adherence.
* Strong analytical depth : comfortable with SQL, experimentation and working alongside Data Science on forecasting and optimisation problems.
* An AI-native mindset : you think naturally about how ML, automation and agents can change how decisions get made, not just how screens look.
* Excellent stakeholder management with senior Operations, Category, Finance and Engineering leaders.
* You thrive in early-stage, fast-moving environments : you'll write the spec, pull the data and walk the floor yourself, and you know the answer is usually a mix of technology, process and operational change.
* Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Business, Economics or a related field.
* An MBA is a plus; strong product experience matters more.

**Good To Have**

* Built or scaled a WMS, inventory platform, procurement system, TMS or promise/ETA engine.
* Experience with fresh, perishable and cold-chain supply chains, including FEFO, grading and expiry management.
* Exposure to demand forecasting, replenishment optimization, slotting, network planning or routing.
* Experience launching and scaling operations across multiple cities and high daily order volumes.
* Experience building frontline workforce products : productivity tracking, incentives, gamification or training.
* Experience shipping AI/ML-driven decisioning or agentic workflows in production operations.

Food is an everyday necessity, but the experience around it can influence how we feel, connect, and go about our day. jobs.description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**THE ROLE**

We are seeking a
**Principal Product Manager**
to lead our Factory Tech within our Sourcing team. Quince is building the operating system for the factories, mills, and vendors that make our products. Factory OS is the software our supply partners run their operations on — planning, scheduling, capacity, quality, and compliance — replacing spreadsheets and disconnected tools with one system of record for how goods actually get made.

As Principal PM, you own this platform end to end: the vision, the roadmap, and the hard calls about what we build, for whom, and in what order. You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with vendors and mills on the factory floor, and with our engineering, ops, and sourcing teams, to turn messy real-world production workflows into reliable software. This is a builder's role with outsized scope — you're defining a category, not iterating on a mature one.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the Factory OS product strategy — from vendor/mill discovery through roadmap, specs, and launch — and be accountable for adoption and measurable operational impact (adoption, on-time production, capacity utilization, quality yield, planning accuracy).
* Design the core operational workflows — production planning, scheduling, capacity management, order and material tracking — so they hold up under the reality of a working factory, not just a demo.
* Build for compliance and auditability from day one. Factory data touches sourcing, labor, quality, and trade requirements. You'll make compliance, traceability, and auditability first-class product surfaces, not bolt-ons — and ensure the system produces the records our partners and Quince are held to.
* Drive real adoption on the floor. A system that vendors and mills won't use is worthless. You'll obsess over onboarding, change management, and the gap between "shipped" and "used daily"
* Set the AI and automation thesis. Architect Factory OS for a future where every automatable workflow is executed by an agent, not a person clicking through screens. Decide which steps to automate first, design the human-in-the-loop and exception paths, and treat agents, APIs, and humans as composable actors in auditable, business-grade workflows.
* Partner deeply cross-functionally with engineering, ML, design, sourcing, and factory operations — translating ambiguous problem statements into shipped products.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* 10+ years in product management, including senior/principal-level ownership of a complex B2B SaaS or operational software product from zero-to-one or through significant scale
* Direct experience building workflow-automation software - you've taken manual, multi-step operational processes and turned them into software that runs them, and you understand the difference between digitizing a workflow and actually automating it.
* Domain proximity to manufacturing, supply chain, or factory/operations software (MES/MOM, ERP, planning/scheduling, quality, or sourcing systems). You don't need to have run a factory, but you need to have built for people who do.
* A credible point of view on AI and agents in production software - not slideware. You've shipped, or can clearly articulate how you'd ship, agentic and human-in-the-loop automation into a real operational system.
* A track record with compliance-sensitive products — you've built software where auditability, traceability, and regulatory or contractual requirements were core to the design.
* Hands-on AI fluency — you use AI tools daily for discovery, spec-writing, and prototyping, and you build to think.
* Comfort in the field — you'll spend time with vendors and mills, and you're energized (not deterred) by messy, physical, real-world operations

**Preferred**

* Experience building software used by external partners/suppliers (not just internal or single-tenant customers).
* Background in apparel, textiles, consumer goods, or hard-goods manufacturing supply chains

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

jobs.description:
Job Description: Data Scientist – Machine Learning & Optimization

**Experience:**
4–6 Years

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

About CoffeeBeans Consulting

CoffeeBeans is a fast-growing technology company delivering high-quality software, data engineering, and AI solutions to clients across industries. We combine deep technical expertise with an agile mindset to solve complex business problems. Our teams work at the intersection of Data Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build intelligent, scalable, and business-focused solutions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Data Scientist with strong expertise in Python, Machine Learning, Time-Series Modelling, and Numerical Optimization. The ideal candidate should have experience working with industrial or process-related data and developing predictive models to improve operational efficiency and optimize manufacturing processes.

The role involves reviewing and enhancing existing ML models, developing predictive solutions using historical and real-time industrial data, and applying constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating parameters. The candidate will also work closely with process engineers, plant operators, and domain experts to translate operational challenges into data-driven solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, evaluate, and improve Machine Learning models using Python for industrial and process-related applications.
* Work with algorithms such as LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM) for predictive modelling.
* Perform feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and explainability to improve model performance.
* Analyse time-series data, historical process data, sensor readings, equipment performance data, and laboratory data to build predictive models.
* Develop forecasting and predictive solutions using lagged features, process variables, and operational parameters.
* Apply numerical and constrained optimization techniques to identify optimal operating conditions.
* Work on multi-objective optimization problems involving throughput, recovery, production efficiency, and operational costs.
* Perform sensitivity analysis and scenario modelling to evaluate the impact of different operating parameters.
* Build and maintain ML pipelines, model inference workflows, and deployment processes.
* Perform live model validation and shadow testing by comparing model predictions against actual plant outcomes.
* Implement model monitoring and feedback mechanisms to ensure model reliability and continuous improvement.
* Collaborate with process engineers, plant operators, and operational SMEs to understand business requirements and deliver practical solutions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–6 years of hands-on experience in Python programming and Machine Learning.
* Strong experience in developing and improving ML models.
* Hands-on experience with LightGBM and Generalized Additive Models (GAM).
* Strong understanding of feature engineering, model validation, diagnostics, and model explainability.
* Experience in Time-Series Modelling, forecasting, and predictive analytics.
* Experience working with industrial process data, sensor data, historian data, or equipment performance data.
* Knowledge of numerical optimization, constrained optimization, and multi-objective optimization techniques.
* Experience with operating parameter optimization, sensitivity analysis, or scenario modelling.
* Understanding of ML pipelines, model deployment, inference workflows, and model monitoring.

Good to Have

* Experience in manufacturing, metals, mining, cement, chemicals, petrochemicals, oil & gas, power, or other process industries.
* Experience in manufacturing optimization, industrial process optimization, or production efficiency improvement.
* Familiarity with metaheuristic algorithms and optimization techniques.
* Experience with Kedro (QuantumBlack) or similar ML pipeline frameworks.
* Experience with API integration, live model testing, and shadow deployment.
* Experience working closely with process engineers, plant operators, and industrial domain experts.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who can combine strong Machine Learning fundamentals with practical industrial problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with complex, time-dependent industrial datasets, improving existing predictive models, and applying optimization techniques to solve real-world manufacturing and operational challenges.

**Job Description:**

**Position: Research Assistant**

**Summary**

The role of a Research Assistant is to support and contribute to ongoing research activities under the Mini Research Grant project titled
*“Degradation Study of Supercapacitor due to Ripple Current”*
at the School of Engineering, Chanakya University. The position involves assisting in experimental investigations, laboratory activities, data collection and analysis, and technical documentation to advance research on supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress, particularly in electric vehicle applications.

**Duration:**
6 months

**Responsibilities**

**Research and Experimental Activities:**

* Assist in conducting research activities related to supercapacitor degradation under power-electronic stress in electric vehicles.
* Support the development and execution of research plans, experimental procedures, and technical investigations.
* Conduct laboratory experiments involving supercapacitors, programmable power sources, electronic loads, and electrical measurement instruments.
* Assist in setting up, operating, and troubleshooting experimental hardware and laboratory equipment.
* Collect, process, analyse, and systematically document experimental data and observations.

**Technical Analysis and Documentation:**

* Conduct literature reviews on supercapacitor technology, degradation mechanisms, ripple current effects, and related power-electronic applications.
* Assist in analysing experimental results and interpreting the effects of electrical stress on supercapacitor performance and degradation.
* Prepare technical reports, research presentations, experimental records, and other project-related documentation.
* Contribute to the preparation of research papers and publications arising from the project.

**Laboratory Management and Support:**

* Assist in maintaining relevant laboratory equipment (power electronics and drives, and energy storage systems), experimental setups, and research-related records.
* Ensure proper handling and operation of electrical and electronic instruments during experimental investigations.
* Follow established laboratory safety procedures and maintain a systematic and organised research environment.

**Collaboration and Research Support:**

* Work collaboratively with the Principal Investigator, faculty members, and other internal and external research personnel to achieve the objectives of the project.
* Participate in research discussions, project reviews, and technical meetings as required.
* Contribute to other project-related research activities and responsibilities as assigned by the Principal Investigator.

**Qualifications Required**

**Essential Qualifications:**

* B.Tech./B.E. in Electrical Engineering (EE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), or a closely related discipline.
* Minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA, subject to university norms.
* Ability to conduct laboratory experiments and work comfortably with electrical and electronic hardware setups.

**Desirable Qualifications:**

* M.Tech./M.E. specialization in Power Electronics, Electric Drives, Energy Storage Systems, or a related area.
* Hands-on experience with programmable electrical sources, power converters, power supplies, electronic loads, electrical measurement instruments, or data acquisition systems.
* Experience in MATLAB/Simulink, LTspice, or equivalent computational tools.
* Previous research project experience or publications related to power electronics, energy storage, or electric vehicle systems.
* Ability to work independently in a research laboratory and systematically document experimental results.

**Experience Required**

* Fresh graduates may apply.
* Relevant laboratory, research, or project experience is desirable.

**Skills Required**

* Fundamentals of electrical engineering principles, power electronics, and energy storage technologies.
* Familiarity with electrical measurement instruments and hardware circuit development.
* Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent engineering simulation tools is desirable.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Dedication to maintaining laboratory safety, and research integrity.

**Duration: Initial appointment for a period of six months, with the possibility of extension based on project requirements and performance.**

Vitalpro Consumer Pvt Ltd is an emerging leader in India’s hospitality and food and beverage sector, known for its innovative and quality-driven approach. The company builds beloved brands such as Saffron & Mishri, which reimagines traditional Indian mithai, and 224 Craftery, which blends global chocolate-making craft with flavors tailored to Indian tastes. Vitalpro focuses on creating memorable culinary experiences that balance tradition with modernity, backed by data-driven insights, precision marketing, and hyper-personalized engagement. With a strong emphasis on creativity, excellence, and people development, the company aims to transform India’s food culture while offering team members a growth-oriented, purpose-led career journey.

**Experience:**
6–12 Years

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Reporting To:**
Founder / Business Head

Role Overview

We are looking for a passionate and experienced New Product Development Lead to drive food innovation across our brands.

The role will be responsible for conceptualising, developing and commercialising differentiated food products across traditional Indian sweets, contemporary confectionery, chocolates, snacking and other food categories.

The ideal candidate should bring a strong understanding of food science, ingredients, formulations, processing technologies and consumer trends, combined with the creativity to develop exciting products and the execution capability to scale them commercially.

Key Responsibilities1. Product Innovation & Concept Development

* Drive the end-to-end new product development pipeline across food categories.
* Identify emerging consumer trends, consumption occasions and product opportunities.
* Develop innovative concepts across mithai, confectionery, chocolates, snacks and other food categories.
* Experiment with new ingredients, flavours, textures, formats and processing techniques.
* Develop differentiated products combining Indian food heritage with contemporary tastes and formats.
* Create product concepts aligned with brand positioning and consumer expectations.

2. Formulation & Product Development

* Lead product formulation, ingredient selection and recipe development.
* Conduct kitchen and laboratory trials to optimise taste, texture, appearance and overall product experience.
* Work on sugar reduction, ingredient optimisation, nutritional profiles and shelf-life enhancement.
* Explore new ingredients, functional ingredients and food technologies.
* Develop alternatives to existing formulations wherever required.
* Ensure products meet applicable FSSAI and food safety requirements.

3. Process Development & Commercialisation

* Translate prototype formulations into scalable commercial products.
* Develop manufacturing processes, process parameters and standard operating procedures.
* Work closely with manufacturing teams to establish production feasibility.
* Identify suitable equipment, technologies and manufacturing processes.
* Drive pilot batches, production trials and product validation.
* Ensure consistency and repeatability across production batches.

4. Quality, Shelf Life & Packaging

* Develop products with appropriate shelf life and stability.
* Work on preservation technologies, packaging compatibility and storage conditions.
* Conduct sensory evaluations, stability studies and shelf-life trials.
* Establish product specifications, quality benchmarks and acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with packaging teams to identify suitable packaging solutions.

5. Costing & Commercial Viability

* Develop product costing and optimise ingredient costs.
* Ensure formulations meet target gross margins without compromising product quality.
* Identify alternative ingredients and vendors.
* Evaluate scalability, manufacturing efficiency and commercial viability.
* Work towards improving product economics through formulation and process optimisation.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Work closely with marketing and brand teams to translate consumer insights into product propositions.
* Collaborate with procurement on ingredient sourcing and vendor development.
* Partner with manufacturing and quality teams for product commercialisation.
* Coordinate with packaging, sales and business teams to ensure successful launches.
* Build and maintain a structured product development calendar and innovation pipeline.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–12 years of experience in food product development, R&D or food innovation.
* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of food ingredients, formulations and processing technologies.
* Experience in developing and commercialising food products at scale.
* Knowledge of shelf-life enhancement, preservation systems and food packaging technologies.
* Understanding of food safety standards, FSSAI regulations and quality systems.
* Strong analytical, experimentation and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to balance creativity, product quality, cost and commercial feasibility.
* Experience working in FMCG, food manufacturing, confectionery or packaged foods preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of successful new product launches.
* Speed and efficiency of product development.
* Product quality, consistency and consumer acceptance.
* Shelf-life and product stability performance.
* Achievement of target product costs and gross margins.
* Successful scale-up from laboratory trials to commercial production.
* Innovation pipeline and launch calendar delivery.

The Ideal Candidate

MARS Cosmetics is a globally recognized beauty brand that thrives on innovation, diversity, and empowering individuals through high-quality beauty solutions. Headquartered in New Delhi, MARS Cosmetics is committed to offering groundbreaking products that meet the ever-evolving needs of consumers worldwide.

**Role Summary**

Own end-to-end skincare and haircare product development from concept to launch, driving formulation, packaging, claims, costing, timelines, and cross-functional execution with internal teams and 3P manufacturers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Lead the NPD pipeline across skincare (serums, gels, emulsions) and haircare (shampoos, conditioners, masks, oils, scalp treatments, styling): identify opportunities, build briefs, define hero claims/USPs, and execute launch plans.

8. Coordinate regulatory readiness for India, including labeling/claims compliance and documentation with RA/QA partners.
9. Benchmark competitors and global trends (actives, delivery systems, textures, formats) and convert them into actionable specs.

**Requirements**

1. 4–8 years in skincare and/or haircare NPD (brand side or OEM/ODM), with multiple launches shipped.
2. Strong formulation and packaging understanding: emulsions/gels/serums for skincare; surfactant systems, conditioning polymers, silicones, and oils for haircare; compatibility and stability basics.
3. Experience running vendor cycles with Indian/China/SEA partners, including iteration discipline, negotiation, and scale-up execution.
4. Strong project management; comfortable with BOM, COGS, MOQ, margin targets, and launch scorecards.
5. High ownership, fast execution, and strong cross-functional communication.

jobs.description:
This is a cGMP and FSSC 22000 certified contract manufacturer specializing in nutrition, protein, energy, granola, and clean-label food bars. Operating from our manufacturing facility at Himalayan Food Park in Kashipur with a daily production capacity of up to 5,00,000 bars, we partner with leading FMCG and nutrition brands to deliver products from concept to shelf.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on **Production Manager** to oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations at our Kashipur plant. You will lead daily shop-floor production across our sheet-and-cut, cold extrusion, baking, enrobing, and packaging lines while ensuring strict adherence to FSSAI, cGMP, and FSSC 22000 food safety standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Planning & Execution:** Plan, schedule, and execute daily and monthly production targets across multiple bar-manufacturing lines (30g–150g SKUs) to ensure on-time order fulfillment.

* **Yield Optimization & Waste Reduction:** Monitor raw material consumption, batch yields, and rework; implement lean manufacturing practices to minimize wastage and downtime.

As the **world’s largest** manufacturer of motorcycles and scooters for the last **25 years**, Hero is where you will get to work with the brightest innovators, passionate about being the best in what they do. **Department:** Service & Technical Support  
**Designation:** Assistant Manager  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years (Automotive Industry Preferred)  
**Qualification:** B.Tech / Diploma in Automobile or Mechanical Engineering  
**Job Location:** Delhi NCR / Field Operations

**1. Job Purpose**

To manage CNG vehicle field issues, provide technical support to dealers, coordinate with OEM and plant quality teams, and ensure timely resolution of customer and dealer complaints. The role will focus on improving product quality, reducing warranty claims, strengthening dealer technical capabilities, and improving service performance.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Field Issue Management**

* Handle and investigate CNG vehicle technical complaints reported by dealers and customers.
* Conduct vehicle inspections and field visits to identify root causes of technical issues.
* Analyse recurring failures and prepare detailed technical investigation reports.
* Coordinate with OEM, Plant Quality, R&D, and Production teams for corrective actions.
* Monitor complaint trends and ensure timely closure of field issues.
* Escalate critical and repetitive issues to senior management.

**B. Dealer Technical Support**

* Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to dealer service teams.
* Plan and conduct dealer visits for technical issue resolution.
* Ensure proper CNG system inspection and repair procedures are followed.
* Support dealers in reducing unnecessary part replacement.
* Monitor dealer technical performance and identify training requirements.

**C. Warranty Management**

* Monitor CNG parts warranty claims and replacement activities.
* Analyse warranty failures and identify high-failure components.
* Coordinate with dealers for defective part return and technical investigation.
* Monitor warranty claim numbers and warranty cost.
* Work towards reducing repeat failures and unnecessary warranty claims.

**D. Technical Training & Development**

* Organise technical training for dealer technicians and service advisors.
* Develop training materials, technical manuals, and troubleshooting guides.
* Conduct practical training on CNG components and diagnostic tools.

**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people, and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.

* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.

* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.

* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

**2. Quality & Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.

* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.

* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.

* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3. Technical & Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.

* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.

* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.

* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4. Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.

* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.

* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5. Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per unit targets.

* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.

* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6. Environment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.

* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7. People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.

* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.

* Certifications (preferred): Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience:**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

* Must have extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.

* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.

* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.

* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.

* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.

* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.

* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Performance Indicators:**

* Production volume vs plan, OEE and line efficiency

* Material yield and wastage percentage

**Job Location:** Noida  
**Salary:** Up to ₹10 LPA  
**Experience:** 6–8+ Years  
**Position:** Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance  
**Industry:** Food / FMCG / Food Manufacturing  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Description

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong Assistant Manager – Quality Assurance to oversee end-to-end quality assurance and food safety operations across third-party manufacturing facilities and 3PL vendors.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring product quality, food safety compliance, vendor quality governance, process monitoring, and regulatory adherence. The role requires hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturers or co-packers, conducting quality audits, implementing corrective and preventive actions, and maintaining food safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Vendor Quality Management & Audits**

* Conduct periodic quality and food safety audits at third-party manufacturing and co-packer facilities.
* Ensure vendor compliance with FSSAI, ISO 22000, FSSC 22000, HACCP, and GMP standards.
* Monitor vendor quality performance and ensure adherence to established quality standards.

**2. In-Process & Finished Product Quality**

* Monitor raw material, packaging material, and finished goods inspection processes at vendor locations.
* Review and approve batch release documentation, Certificates of Analysis (COAs), and laboratory reports before dispatch.
* Ensure temperature compliance during product receiving, storage, and dispatch.

**3. CAPA & Root Cause Analysis**

* Lead Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for customer complaints, non-conformances, and audit observations.
* Manage product hold and release processes, scrap/rework activities, and mock recall exercises.
* Ensure timely closure of quality-related issues.

**4. Process & Hygiene Monitoring**

* Monitor Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Good Hygiene Practices (GHP), pest control, and sanitation programs.
* Oversee Cleaning-in-Place (CIP) validation and process control checks.
* Ensure food safety and hygiene standards are consistently maintained at third-party facilities.

**5. Cross-Functional & Vendor Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal R&D, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Operations teams, along with external vendor quality teams.
* Train vendor personnel on quality standards, food safety practices, and testing protocols.
* Drive continuous improvement in vendor quality performance.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology, Dairy Technology, or Biotechnology.
* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance / Quality Control within the Food, FMCG, or Contract Manufacturing industry.
* Hands-on experience in managing third-party manufacturing units, vendors, or co-packers is essential.
* Strong knowledge of FSSAI regulations, HACCP, GMP, and Food Safety Management Systems (FSMS).
* Working knowledge of FSSC 22000 and ISO 22000 standards.
* Experience in quality audits, CAPA, Root Cause Analysis, FMEA, and statistical quality tools.
* Strong vendor management, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Good team management and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently to third-party manufacturing facilities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone with strong expertise in food safety, vendor quality management, and third-party manufacturing operations, who can independently drive quality standards and ensure regulatory compliance across multiple vendor facilities.

**Interested candidates are requested to share their updated resumes for consideration.**

Pay: ₹900,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**Jubilant Bhartia Group**
--------------------------

**Jubilant Bhartia Group**

-----------------------------

Jubilant Pharmova Limited (formerly Jubilant Life Sciences Limited) is a company with global presence that is involved in Radiopharma, Allergy Immunotherapy, CDMO Sterile Injectables, Contract Research Development and Manufacturing Organisation (CRDMO), Generics and Proprietary Novel Drugs businesses.

In the Radiopharma business, the Company is involved in manufacturing and supply of Radiopharmaceuticals with a network of 46 radio-pharmacies in the US. The Company’s Allergy Immunotherapy business is involved in the manufacturing and supply of allergic extracts and venom products in the US and in some other markets such as Canada, Europe and Australia. Jubilant through its CDMO Sterile Injectables business offers manufacturing services including sterile fill and finish injectables (both liquid and lyophilization), full-service ophthalmic offer (liquids, ointments & creams) and ampoules.

The CRDMO business of the Company includes the Drug Discovery Services business that provides contract research and development services through two world-class research centres in Bangalore and Noida in India and the CDMO-API business that is involved in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients. Jubilant Therapeutics is involved in Proprietary Novel Drugs business and is an innovative biopharmaceutical company developing breakthrough therapies in the area of oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six manufacturing facilities that cater to all the regulated market including USA, Europe and other geographies.

**The Position**
----------------

The Project Financial Analyst supports financial governance, risk management, and cost control for pharmaceutical R&D and CapEx projects, including manufacturing and equipment sourcing. Serving as the primary financial partner to Project Managers, Engineering, Clinical Development, and Operations globally, the analyst supports financial discipline and data-driven decisions. * Conduct monthly variance analysis comparing actual costs to budgets and adjust for timing, price, scope, or inefficiencies
* Assist in cost estimates and tracking for new and multi-year projects while maintaining SAP records
* Update rolling cash flow and Estimate at Completion (EAC) forecasts and monitor cost and schedule performance
* Identify financial risks early and create dashboards with KPIs to alert teams and management
* Present monthly and quarterly variance reports explaining financial impacts of delays

* Support procurement in managing vendor agreements, change orders, and invoice compliance

Position: Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology

**Department:**
Preclinical Sciences

**Reports To:**
Chief Scientific Officer

**Location:**
On-site, Full-time

Role Overview

VMRC is advancing a diversified pipeline spanning novel anti-infectives, BL+BLI combinations, and differentiated herbal therapeutics. The Head – Animal Pharmacology & Toxicology will lead all in vivo pharmacology, ADME, toxicology, translational PK–PD, and pharmacometrics activities across the portfolio.

This is a senior scientific leadership role requiring deep expertise in anti-infective development, renal pharmacology, nephrotoxicity assessment, PK–PD modelling, and IND-enabling toxicology, combined with strong regulatory and team leadership capability.

Key Programmes

Renal Guard Programme (Phase 1)

A reformulated polymyxin programme focused on reducing nephrotoxicity while maintaining antimicrobial efficacy.

Key areas:

* Renal injury biomarkers: KIM-1, NGAL, Cystatin C, NAG, Osteopontin
* Renal pharmacology and drug disposition
* Histopathology integration
* Complex PK interpretation in limited-literature settings

Meropenem + MET-X Programme (Late Preclinical)

A BL+BLI combination targeting carbapenem-resistant Gram-negative infections.

Key areas:

* IND-enabling ADME and toxicology
* Translational PK–PD
* Monte Carlo simulation & PTA
* Dose optimisation using:
* fT>MIC
* fAUC/MIC
* Cmax/MIC
* Clinical dose projection and resistance suppression strategy

Qualifications & Experience

* Ph.D. in Pharmacology, Toxicology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Translational Medicine, or related discipline
* 10+ years in preclinical in vivo drug development
* 5+ years leading multidisciplinary preclinical teams
* Experience advancing assets through IND/CTA-enabling development
* Strong expertise in:
* Anti-infectives
* Toxicology
* Renal pharmacology
* PK–PD/pharmacometrics
* GLP laboratory and regulatory submission experience preferred
* Strong publication and scientific presentation record

Key Responsibilities

Scientific Leadership

* Define and execute portfolio-wide in vivo strategy
* Lead pharmacology, toxicology, ADME, and PK–PD functions
* Serve as Study Director/PI for internal and outsourced studies
* Lead team development, budgeting, infrastructure, and resource planning
* Interface with CMC, microbiology, clinical, regulatory, and bioanalytical teams

In Vivo Pharmacology & Infection Models

* Thigh
* Lung
* Sepsis
* Resistance amplification
* Dose-fractionation studies
* Evaluate exposure–response, bacterial burden, survival, and resistance suppression

Renal Pharmacology & Toxicology

ADME & Translational PK–PD

* Phoenix WinNonlin

Regulatory & GLP

* IAEC/CPCSEA guidelines
* IBSC requirements
* ARRIVE & 3Rs principles
* IND/CTA/NDA nonclinical documentation

Ideal Candidate

* Expertise in nephrotoxicity and renal biomarker science
* Strong translational and regulatory mindset

The skills for success

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. **Company Description**

Syngenta Bioscience Private Limited (SBPL) is one of Syngenta's three global Research & Technology centers, our Goa facility stands at the forefront of agricultural innovation. Our world-class team specializes in developing novel active ingredients, pioneering sustainable synthesis routes and advancing cutting-edge chemical technologies. We have diverse scientific talent pool, with deep expertise in organic chemistry, drives solutions that enhance global food security and sustainable agriculture. At SBPL Goa, we combine scientific excellence with meaningful career growth opportunities, contributing directly to Syngenta's mission of feeding a growing world sustainably.

 **Job Description**

**Role Purpose**

Lead the Analytical team of 5 to 6 scientists in delivering reliable, timely and compliant analytical support to Product Chemistry, Formulation Development, Technology & Sourcing, Manufacturing and Quality. The role requires strong technical expertise, structured problem solving, people leadership, and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Technical and Operational Excellence**

* Lead analytical testing, method development, validation, transfer, verification and troubleshooting activities for active ingredients, intermediates, formulations and relevant raw materials.
* Ensure methods, instruments, laboratory systems and data meet applicable Quality, Health Safety and Environment (HSE), Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and data-integrity requirements.
* Provide expert scientific judgement for complex deviations, out-of-specification results, investigations, root-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions.
* Drive laboratory efficiency, robustness and continuous improvement through fit-for-purpose technologies, standardization, automation and lean ways of working.
* Ensure high-quality technical reports, analytical documentation and defensible scientific data to support product, process and regulatory decisions.
* Manage laboratory resources, priorities, capacity, equipment readiness and budget to meet agreed service levels.

**People Leadership**

* Build a capable, engaged and inclusive Analytical team through clear objectives, regular feedback, coaching and performance management.
* Develop technical capability, succession pipelines and individual development plans using structured learning, peer learning and on-the-job experience.
* Promote a culture of scientific curiosity, ownership, collaboration, safety, quality and continuous improvement.
* Recruit, retain and develop talent; ensure appropriate competency assessment and training for laboratory roles.
* Lead by example in applying Syngenta behaviours and creating a respectful, diverse and rightful working environment. The internal people-management framework highlights talent development, coaching and inclusive leadership as core expectations.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Partner closely with Product Chemistry, Process Technology, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Supply, HSE and external laboratories/suppliers.
* Translate business and technical needs into clear analytical strategies, plans, priorities and realistic delivery commitments.
* Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and influence decisions at project, site and regional levels.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively, escalating risks, resource constraints and technical issues early with practical options for resolution.

Are you ready to inspire? #MakingWinners #InspireXT #SupplyChainExperts

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Food & Beverage Industry Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 15+ years of industry experience and strong domain expertise in Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), product specification management, packaging development and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate should have a deep understanding of end-to-end F&B product lifecycle processes, including product development, formulation, ingredient management, raw material specifications, packaging specifications, finished goods, quality management and product commercialization.

The candidate will play a critical role in providing functional and domain expertise for PLM transformation initiatives, helping translate business requirements into scalable digital solutions. The role will involve working closely with business stakeholders, product development teams, R&D, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Packaging, Manufacturing and IT teams.

A sound understanding of global food regulatory frameworks, particularly EU and USA regulations, is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**

PLM & Product Lifecycle Management

  

* Provide subject matter expertise across the end-to-end product lifecycle, from ideation and product development to commercialization and product maintenance.
* Understand and define PLM processes covering product development, formulation, ingredient management, product specifications, quality and change management.
* Drive standardization of PLM processes, workflows, approval mechanisms and governance across business functions.
* Define business requirements and translate them into functional specifications for PLM platform implementation.
* Support PLM transformation initiatives, process optimization and digitalization programmes.

Product Specification Management

  

* Demonstrate strong expertise in managing product specifications across raw materials, ingredients, intermediates, finished goods and packaging materials.
* Understand specification attributes, technical data, nutritional information, allergen declarations, composition, physical and chemical properties and quality parameters.
* Define and manage specification lifecycle processes, including creation, review, approval, version control and obsolescence.
* Understand specification relationships, hierarchies, inheritance, dependencies and cross functional data requirements.
* Establish governance for specification accuracy, completeness, traceability and data integrity.

Packaging Management

  

* Provide functional expertise in primary, secondary and tertiary packaging processes and specifications.
* Understand packaging materials, structures, dimensions, weights, artwork, labeling, packaging components and material compliance.
* Support packaging development, packaging change management, supplier collaboration and packaging approval processes.
* Understand packaging sustainability, recyclability, material composition and environmental compliance requirements.
* Work with packaging engineering, procurement, quality and regulatory teams to define packaging specifications and associated workflows.

Global Regulatory & Compliance Requirements

  

* Possess a sound understanding of food safety, product labeling, ingredient declarations, packaging compliance and regulatory requirements across global markets.
* Understand supplier declarations, Certificates of Analysis (CoA), Certificates of Compliance (CoC), Statements of Composition and Declarations of Conformity (DoC).
* Work with regulatory teams to ensure product and packaging specifications capture relevant compliance attributes and documentation.
* Familiarity with EU regulatory frameworks, including:

* EU Regulation 178/2002 – General Food Law.
* EU Regulation 1169/2011 – Food Information to Consumers.
* EU Regulation 1935/2004 – Food Contact Materials.
* EU Regulation 10/2011 – Plastic Materials Intended to Come into Contact with Food.
* EU Regulation 2025/40 – Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR).
* REACH and applicable chemical substance compliance requirements.
* Familiarity with USA regulatory frameworks, including:

* FDA Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA).
* FDA 21 CFR requirements applicable to food and food packaging.
* Food allergen labelling requirements under FALCPA and FASTER Act.
* FDA food contact substance requirements.
* Nutrition Facts and ingredient declaration requirements.
* Applicable food packaging and labelling compliance requirements.

Business Process & Stakeholder Management

* Engage with R&D, Product Development, Packaging, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing, Procurement and Supply Chain stakeholders.
* Conduct business workshops, discovery sessions, process assessments and fit-gap analysis.
* Document AS-IS and TO-BE business processes, functional requirements and process flows.
* Define business rules, approval workflows, roles and responsibilities.
* Support solution demonstrations, functional validation, UAT and business acceptance.
* Act as the domain bridge between business stakeholders and technology implementation teams.

PLM Platform Implementation & Transformation

  

* Provide functional leadership during PLM platform implementation and transformation programmes.
* Support configuration of product, ingredient, specification, packaging and regulatory management capabilities.
* Define functional requirements for data migration, integrations and reporting.
* Support product data governance, master data management and specification harmonization.
* Participate in solution design reviews, sprint planning, testing, defect resolution and deployment.
* Support user training, change management and post-implementation stabilization.

**Key Deliverables**

  

* Business process assessment and AS-IS / TO-BE documentation.
* Functional requirements and PLM solution design inputs.
* Product, ingredient, raw material and finished goods specification models.
* Packaging specification and lifecycle management processes.
* Regulatory and compliance requirement mapping for EU and USA markets.
* Functional workflows, approval processes and change management definitions.
* Data migration mapping and specification governance inpu

Manorama is recognized for its advanced quality processes and standards, supported by modern R&D and product development technologies, enabling it to deliver high-performance solutions that closely mimic cocoa butter profiles. The company is committed to sustainable practices, including zero carbon emission initiatives and empowering tribal women through self-help groups, combining commercial success with social and environmental responsibility.

**Role Description**
Build and run the Company's compliance, risk and regulatory function as one office. Own the compliance framework and the enterprise risk register; ensure that every licence, approval, registration and certification required to make, import, export and sell the Company's specialty fats and new products is obtained and kept current; ensure products meet the regulatory requirements of their destination markets; and anticipate and manage regulatory risk across food safety, foreign trade, environment, factory/PESO and export market access — in coordination with the Company Secretary, Legal and the Occupier/Factory Manager.The Head of Compliance and Regulatory signs the Company's first compliance certificate to the Audit Committee in November 2027 and takes over as lead of the Board-approved compliance programme on joining. This full-time, on-site role based in Raipur involves developing and maintaining compliance frameworks, monitoring regulatory changes, and translating them into actionable policies and procedures. The role includes overseeing audits and inspections, coordinating with legal, quality, manufacturing, and supply chain teams, and preparing documentation for regulatory filings and certifications. Own FSSAI licensing (manufacturing, storage, import, export), product approvals, standards and labelling for all products; secure categorisation / approval for new products and manage any port-sampling / clearance representations. Own DGFT matters — IEC, Advance Authorisations and export-obligation compliance, RCMCs, status-holder and the Import SOP — and coordinate Customs and related representations with Legal and the Company Secretary.

**Qualifications**

•   About 18–25 years' experience, with 5+ years leading compliance, risk, regulatory affairs or internal audit at a listed company or a multinational's Indian business.

•   Hands-on FSSAI — licensing, product approvals, standards and labelling — and DGFT / EXIM (IEC, Advance Authorisations, export-obligation compliance, the import framework).

•   Export market-access experience, including clearing products for the EU.

•   Has designed and run a compliance register and law calendar; has reported to an Audit Committee or Board under challenge.

* Strong expertise in Compliance Management and Regulatory Compliance within food, edible oils, specialty fats, FMCG, or nutrition industries.
* In-depth understanding of relevant Regulations and Legal Compliance requirements at national and international levels.
* Advanced Analytical Skills to assess regulatory impact, interpret complex guidelines, and recommend practical solutions.
* Proven experience leading compliance or regulatory functions, preferably at a senior or head-of-department level.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law, Food Technology, Food Science, Nutrition, Chemistry, or a related discipline.
* Familiarity with global food safety and quality standards (e.g., FSSAI, Codex, HACCP, ISO, BRC or similar frameworks).
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and locations.

**Job Description – Strategy and Policy Division, Quality Council of India (Hiring for Policy, Legal, Tech and Marketing roles)**

**About the Team**

Strategy and Policy Division (SPD) of the QCI is a team of young professionals working towards augmenting the capacity of government bodies in policy making and formulating high-level strategies for projects that address national priorities. Our work at SPD entails numerous domains, which includes creation of a national level product label scheme, a flagship initiative of the Government of India. The team functions as a high-impact delivery unit within QCI, combining policy research, regulatory analysis, and project execution in a fast-paced, government-facing environment.

**Role Summary**

Your role will support the end-to-end operationalisation of various policies & schemes that QCI designs & implements. The support largely involves regulatory research, creating systems, SOP drafting to stakeholder coordination with regulators and industry associations. Depending on the experience, you would be designated as an Analyst, Associate Manager, or Project Manager (see Section 6). This role blends regulatory and standards domain knowledge with policy research, and scheme-level project management.

**Why This Role Is a Unique Opportunity**

This is not a typical corporate or consulting role. You will be at the centre of building India’s branding framework from the ground up – a programme with direct implications for achieving the goals of Atmanirbhar and Viksit Bharat. The work you do here will shape real policy outcomes.

We are looking for individuals who want to point to a national programme and say, “I helped build that.” If you have domain knowledge in manufacturing, standards, or trade policy, combined with intellectual rigour and a commitment to public service, this is the place for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

**There are 4 different roles (listed from A to D below) for which we are hiring multiple candidates-**

**A. Strategy & Policy**

* **Research & Synthesis:**
  Research BIS, FSSAI and international standards, testing procedures, QCOs, DGFT import-export regulations, HSN codes, rules of origin, NTBs and SPS rules, and turn findings into concise briefs and policy notes for QCI, DPIIT and other stakeholders.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse sector-level manufacturing and trade data (production, import penetration, localisation, HS-code trade flows) for sector selection, threshold-setting and impact assessment, and present it through dashboards, leadership and ministerial decks, and research, benchmarking and progress reports.
* **Drafting & Documentation:**
  Draft Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, FAQs, proposal notes, inter-ministerial correspondence and approval documents in government format.
* **Stakeholder & Project Coordination:**
  Coordinate with BIS, BEE, DGFT, Department of Commerce, CII, FICCI, ASSOCHAM and Sector Council members; prepare agendas, minutes and trackers; and track scheme milestones (portal, sector onboarding, Sector Councils) with ministries and QCI leadership.

**B. Legal**

* **Legal Vetting & Drafting:**
  Draft and vet Scheme Guidelines, SOPs, Sector Addenda, undertakings, certificate holder terms, portal terms and privacy notices, MoUs and vendor contracts; prepare legal notes, opinions and file notings; and flag legal risk before any document is issued.
* **Enforcement, Disputes & Litigation:**
  Draft show-cause notices, suspension and cancellation orders, and grievance and appeal decisions in line with natural justice and SOP timelines. Manage challenges from notice to outcome: keep the court and limitation calendar, brief counsel, review pleadings, attend hearings, advise on appeals, and coordinate with the nodal Department where the Union of India is a party.
* **Law Firm & Panel Management:**
  Empanel law firms and counsel; allocate matters, fix scope and fees in work orders and check invoices; and hold firms to QCI’s standards on availability, forum coverage (Supreme Court to district courts, tribunals and consumer fora), conflicts and reporting.
* **IP & Brand Protection:**
  Protect the scheme’s name, logo and QR mark in India and abroad: trademark and certification mark filings, licence terms, register watch, oppositions, online takedowns, cease and desist notices and infringement actions.
* **Regulatory & Trade Law Research:**
  Interpret the BIS Act and QCOs, FSSAI, Legal Metrology, Foreign Trade Policy, customs and rules of origin, WTO and FTA obligations, trademark and GI law, the Consumer Protection Act and CCPA guidelines, and the DPDP and RTI Acts, and brief leadership at QCI and DPIIT.
* **Coordination, Records & Reporting:**
  Coordinate with DPIIT, BIS, DGFT, CCPA, law officers and industry bodies; maintain the Matter Register and precedent bank and feed lessons into SOPs; safeguard manufacturer data (including BOM and cost data); handle RTI and grievance responses; and report on open matters, risk and legal spend.

**C. Technology (Scheme Portal)**

* **Requirements, Design & Product Ownership:**
  Translate the Scheme Guidelines and SOPs into requirements, process flows, user stories and acceptance criteria for each portal module; own the backlog and release roadmap; and review the vendor’s UI/UX, architecture, data models and integrations so the portal is simple for MSMEs, bilingual, mobile-responsive and accessible.
* **Vendor & Delivery Management:**
  Support the RFP and bid evaluation; govern the vendor against plan, milestones and SLAs; assess change requests for scope, effort and cost; and verify deliverables before milestone payments.
* **Testing, Security & Go-Live:**
  Run UAT, triage defects and sign off releases; oversee go-live, data migration and rollback; and ensure CERT-In empanelled audits, compliance with GIGW, the DPDP Act, 2023 and hosting norms, and sound backups, disaster recovery, access control and audit trails.
* **Operations, Support & Reporting:**
  Monitor uptime, helpdesk and incidents against SLAs; secure documentation and knowledge transfer to avoid vendor lock-in; coordinate manuals and training; and define MIS dashboards for QCI and DPIIT.

**D. Marketing & IEC**

* **Marketing Strategy, Research & Campaign Planning:**
  Support the development of marketing and IEC strategies, campaign plans, audience segmentation, communication objectives and key messages, informed by market, audience and communication research and stakeholder feedback.
* **Brand Communication & Content Development:**
  Develop and coordinate clear, consistent communication materials such as brochures, presentations, FAQs, reports, infographics, videos, digital creatives and campaign content.
* **Digital Marketing, Monitoring & Reporting:**
  Coordinate digital outreach, social media content calendars, channel dissemination and audience engagement; track outreach coverage, participation, digital reach and engagement; and use these insights to refine communication and prepare periodic reports and recommendations.
* **Outreach, Events & Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Support awareness campaigns, workshops, conferences, trade fairs and outreach activities; coordinate with internal teams, industry bodies, partners and other stakeholders.
* **Agency & Vendor Coordination:**
  Coordinate briefs, deliverables, timelines and quality reviews with marketing, creative, media, event and IEC agencies or vendors.

Genuine interest in India’s manufacturing, trade and standards ecosystem and its policy developments.

**Company:** CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd.

**Salary:** ₹50,000–₹60,000 gross per month, plus employer PF and annual performance bonus as per company policy.

About the Company

CTB Foods & Hospitality Pvt. Ltd. is a growing B2B bakery manufacturer supplying burger buns, breads, pitas, pizza bases and specialty bakery products to restaurants, cafés, QSRs and cloud kitchens.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive, hands-on QA professional to **take ownership of our quality assurance and food safety function**.

This is a leadership role requiring someone who can independently assess existing practices, establish effective quality systems, implement improvements and ensure consistent standards throughout our manufacturing operations.

**We are looking for a person who takes initiative, solves problems and drives results—not someone who simply conducts inspections or maintains records.**

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead and develop the QA/QC function**, establishing effective quality systems, SOPs, inspection procedures and operational controls.
* **Ensure product quality and process compliance** throughout manufacturing, from incoming materials and ingredient preparation to production, packaging and finished goods.
* **Own food safety and regulatory compliance**, including FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, sanitation, hygiene, audits and required documentation.
* **Establish and maintain traceability, quality records and product release controls**, ensuring audit readiness and effective management of nonconformities.
* **Investigate quality issues and customer complaints**, identify root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and prevent recurrence.
* **Lead and guide QA personnel**, train production teams and work closely with other departments to ensure quality standards are consistently followed.
* **Drive continuous improvement**, proactively identifying weaknesses, implementing practical solutions and monitoring measurable results.
* Report quality performance and critical risks directly to management, taking responsibility for follow-up and resolution.

Candidate Requirements

* Degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Microbiology or a related discipline.
* Minimum **5 years of QA/QC experience in food manufacturing**; bakery experience preferred.
* Strong practical knowledge of FSSAI, GMP, GHP, HACCP, quality documentation and audits.
* Demonstrated experience implementing or improving QA systems, SOPs, process controls and CAPA.
* Ability to independently manage QA activities, guide staff and coordinate effectively with production teams.
* Strong organizational, analytical, communication and problem-solving skills.
* Hands-on approach, high personal accountability and the ability to follow through without constant supervision.

**Preference will be given to candidates who have personally established, implemented or substantially improved quality systems in a food manufacturing facility.**

What We Offer

An opportunity to lead and develop the quality function of a growing food manufacturing company, with significant autonomy, direct interaction with management and the ability to make a measurable impact.

**Work Schedule:** Primarily daytime hours, with flexibility for occasional night-time production visits as required. This is not a permanent night-shift position.

Benefits:

* Provident Fund
