Job Description: Café & Premium Grocery Store LeadJob Overview

The Café & Premium Grocery Store Lead is responsible for overseeing the overall operations of both the café and premium grocery retail sections. This dual role involves managing food preparation and café services, supervising grocery store operations, ensuring excellent customer experiences, managing staff, maintaining inventory, and driving business profitability.

The role requires a combination of culinary expertise, retail management, team leadership, merchandising skills, and operational excellence. The individual will ensure that the café and grocery store operate seamlessly while maintaining premium quality standards, product presentation, hygiene, and customer satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities1. Café Operations & Food Preparation

* Oversee daily café operations, including food preparation, cooking, and beverage services.
* Ensure all food and beverages are prepared according to recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Coordinate with the team to develop seasonal menus, daily specials, and new offerings.
* Ensure smooth coordination between kitchen and front-of-house operations.
* Monitor service speed and efficiency, particularly during peak hours.

2. Premium Grocery Store Operations

* Manage the day-to-day operations of the premium grocery store.
* Ensure proper product arrangement, display, merchandising, and shelf presentation.
* Maintain premium standards across all grocery categories, including fresh produce, packaged foods, gourmet products, beverages, bakery items, and specialty ingredients.
* Ensure products are properly priced, labelled, displayed, and replenished.
* Monitor product quality, freshness, and expiry dates.
* Ensure an attractive, organized, and premium shopping environment.
* Introduce new products and categories based on customer preferences and market trends.

3. Inventory & Procurement Management

* Oversee inventory management for both café ingredients and grocery products.
* Monitor stock levels and ensure timely replenishment.
* Coordinate with suppliers and vendors for procurement, pricing, and product availability.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, stock movement, wastage, and returns.
* Monitor product shelf life and implement effective FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Minimize food wastage, stock losses, and inventory discrepancies.
* Ensure cost-effective purchasing without compromising quality.

4. Staff Management & Training

* Recruit, train, supervise, and manage café and grocery store staff.
* Manage baristas, cooks, kitchen assistants, cashiers, sales associates, and store attendants.
* Prepare staff schedules and ensure adequate manpower during peak hours.
* Conduct regular training on product knowledge, food preparation, customer service, hygiene, and store operations.
* Monitor employee performance and provide regular feedback.
* Promote teamwork, accountability, and a customer-focused work culture.

5. Customer Service & Experience

* Ensure exceptional customer service across both the café and grocery store.
* Create a welcoming, friendly, and premium customer experience.
* Assist customers with product recommendations, menu selections, and product information.
* Handle customer feedback, complaints, and service-related issues professionally.
* Build customer relationships and encourage repeat visits.
* Maintain high standards of hospitality and service excellence.

6. Financial & Business Management

* Monitor overall business performance, including café sales and grocery retail revenue.
* Track daily sales, operating expenses, cash flow, and profitability.
* Manage POS operations, billing, cash handling, and daily sales reconciliation.
* Monitor food costs, product margins, wastage, and operating expenses.
* Develop strategies to improve sales, profitability, and operational efficiency.
* Identify opportunities for cross-selling between the café and grocery store.
* Prepare regular sales, inventory, and operational performance reports.

7. Hygiene, Cleanliness & Compliance

* Ensure high standards of cleanliness and hygiene across the café, kitchen, storage areas, and grocery store.
* Maintain compliance with applicable food safety, sanitation, and health regulations.
* Ensure proper food handling, storage, labelling, and temperature control.
* Conduct regular hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure equipment, kitchen workstations, shelves, and customer areas are clean and well-maintained.
* Maintain applicable food safety documentation and licences, including FSSAI compliance in India.

8. Visual Merchandising & Store Presentation

* Maintain an attractive and premium look across the grocery store and café.
* Ensure proper product placement, signage, pricing, and promotional displays.
* Implement seasonal displays and themed product arrangements.
* Maintain consistency in the brand's visual identity and customer experience.
* Ensure shelves, counters, café seating, and display areas are always organized.

9. Marketing, Promotions & Business Growth

* Plan and implement local marketing initiatives to increase footfall and customer engagement.
* Develop promotional campaigns, combo offers, seasonal menus, and special events.
* Promote new grocery products, café offerings, and exclusive premium selections.
* Encourage customer feedback and use insights to improve products and services.
* Identify opportunities for partnerships, community engagement, and repeat customer programmes.
* Drive cross-selling and upselling opportunities between the café and grocery store.

Qualifications & Experience

* Proven experience in café management, restaurant operations, premium retail, supermarket, or gourmet grocery store management.
* Experience managing both food service and retail operations will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of café operations, food preparation, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of premium grocery products, retail merchandising, and inventory management.
* Experience in staff management, vendor coordination, and procurement.
* Understanding of budgeting, sales tracking, cost control, and profitability.
* Knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Experience with POS systems, billing, and inventory management software will be an advantage.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and people management skills.
* Excellent communication and customer service abilities.
* Culinary knowledge and food preparation skills.
* Retail operations and merchandising expertise.
* Inventory management and procurement skills.
* Financial management and cost-control capabilities.
* Product knowledge and an understanding of premium food and grocery categories.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Sales-driven mindset with a focus on business growth and profitability.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The performance of the Café & Premium Grocery Store Lead will be evaluated based on:

* Overall sales growth and profitability.
* Café food quality and customer satisfaction.
* Grocery store sales and product movement.
* Inventory accuracy and stock availability.
* Food wastage and stock loss reduction.
* Staff productivity and retention.
* Customer feedback and repeat business

jobs.title: Product Development & Global Sourcing
jobs.description:
Glasafe is a fast-growing Indian consumer brand specializing in premium borosilicate glassware, drinkware, food storage containers, and innovative kitchen and lifestyle products.

We are looking for a commercially driven and resourceful professional who can lead new product discovery, global supplier sourcing, product development, and procurement activities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys exploring international markets, discovering innovative products, working directly with factories, and converting ideas into commercially successful products.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Product Research & Development – 30%

\* Continuously research Indian and international markets to identify emerging product trends, innovations, and new launch opportunities.

\* Study competitor products, customer preferences, pricing, product features, and market gaps.

\* Identify products with strong potential for the Indian D2C, e-commerce, quick-commerce, and retail markets.

\* Develop new product concepts in coordination with the internal design, marketing, and management teams.

\* Work directly with manufacturers to customize product designs, materials, features, packaging, and functionality.

\* Evaluate product feasibility, target selling prices, manufacturing costs, and potential profitability.

\* Maintain an active pipeline of new product ideas and launch opportunities.

2. Global Vendor Identification & Sourcing – 30%

\* Identify and develop reliable manufacturers across China, India, Taiwan, Vietnam, Thailand, and other global manufacturing markets.

\* Independently research factories through sourcing platforms, industry networks, trade exhibitions, and direct outreach.

\* Evaluate manufacturers based on production capabilities, quality standards, pricing, innovation, and reliability.

\* Develop relationships with OEM and ODM manufacturers for customized product development.

\* Negotiate factory prices, MOQs, tooling costs, payment terms, and delivery schedules.

\* Identify alternative manufacturers to reduce sourcing costs and supplier dependency.

\* Explore opportunities for domestic manufacturing, component sourcing, and local assembly.

3. Product Sampling & Commercialization – 20%

\* Coordinate product sampling from initial concept to final approved sample.

\* Work with factories and the internal design team on product modifications and improvements.

\* Evaluate samples for quality, functionality, durability, finish, and commercial viability.

\* Coordinate prototype development, mould modifications, packaging, and branding requirements.

\* Compare supplier quotations and prepare detailed product cost sheets.

\* Ensure timely development and approval of samples.

\* Coordinate with internal teams to transition approved products into bulk production.

4. Import Management & Procurement – 20%

\* Handle international procurement and coordinate import-related activities.

\* Understand import costing, including FOB, CIF, freight, customs duties, IGST, clearing charges, and inland transportation.

\* Prepare accurate landed-cost calculations for imported products.

\* Understand Incoterms, HS codes, import documentation, and applicable Indian customs regulations.

\* Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and overseas suppliers.

\* Track purchase orders, production schedules, shipments, and delivery timelines.

\* Negotiate procurement terms and optimize total landed costs.

\* Ensure smooth coordination between suppliers, logistics partners, and internal operations.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

\* 5–10 years of experience in new product development, international sourcing, vendor development, or procurement.

\* Strong experience sourcing products directly from overseas manufacturers, particularly China.

\* Proven ability to identify new products and take them from concept through sampling to commercial production.

\* Experience working with OEM/ODM factories and customized product development.

\* Strong negotiation skills with a good understanding of manufacturing costs and supplier economics.

\* Working knowledge of international trade, customs duties, Incoterms, and import costing.

\* Ability to independently research suppliers, compare quotations, and prepare commercial feasibility reports.

\* Strong Excel, analytical, communication, and vendor-management skills.

\* Willingness to travel internationally for factory visits, supplier development, and trade exhibitions.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates from the following industries will be preferred:

\* Kitchenware, glassware, and houseware

\* Drinkware, food storage, and lifestyle products

\* Consumer durables and home products

\* D2C consumer brands

\* Import-oriented trading and sourcing companies

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

**Performance will be measured through:**

1. Number of commercially viable new product opportunities identified.

2. Number of new manufacturers and suppliers developed.

3. Number of new products successfully sampled and launched.

4. Product development timelines from concept to approved sample.

5. Cost savings achieved through sourcing, negotiation, and product engineering.

6. Quality, reliability, and competitiveness of suppliers.

7. Accuracy of landed-cost calculations and timely import coordination.

**Ideal Candidate**

We are looking for a product hunter and developer, not just a purchase-order manager.

The ideal candidate should be curious about new products, proactive in discovering manufacturers, commercially sharp in negotiations, and capable of independently driving product development.

They should be comfortable working directly with overseas factories, challenging existing product designs, finding better manufacturing solutions, and bringing innovative, competitively priced products to the Indian market.

Role Focus: 80% New Product Development, Global Sourcing & Vendor Development | 20% Procurement & Import Management.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹67,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

**Overview:**
The Senior Research Associate independently develops renovation and innovation products from formulation and laboratory evaluation through application validation, factory trials, scale-up, and transfer to manufacturing. This hands-on role requires regular work in Kemin and external laboratories and the ability to plan and execute factory trials at Kemin’s manufacturing facility. The role serves as the product owner for assigned products from concept to launch.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Renovation and Innovation Projects**

* Design and execute robust experiments using appropriate controls, replication, statistical methods, and predefined acceptance criteria.

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, a Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club.

We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation and Merchandise lines of business as well as other initiatives including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As a Senior Software Engineer within Disney Experiences Technology, you will help create immersive digital products that bring Disney’s stories to life across theme parks, resorts, cruise vacations, and consumer experiences worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker who solves complex problems, mentors less experienced colleagues, and contributes effective, high-quality solutions that enhance guest and business experiences.

**Responsibilities:**

In this role, you will design, build, test, and maintain software solutions that support end-to-end guest and business journeys across Disney Experiences, from travel and vacation planning to in-park and retail interactions. You will work with minimal guidance, act as a resource for teammates, and apply your problem-solving skills to deliver effective, scalable systems that help Disney provide creative, customer-focused, and innovative experiences around the world. This role matters because it ensures our technology is reliable, performant, and easy to evolve, requiring a proficient engineer who is detail-oriented, collaborative, and able to explain complex concepts clearly.

* Conceive, design, develop, test, and implement software components, enhancements, fixes, and new applications across web and cloud-based platforms.
* Contribute to and sometimes lead the design and implementation of custom applications, integrations, microservices, and APIs that support high-volume, highly scalable systems.

* Monitor applications using tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, or similar solutions, troubleshoot production issues, and proactively improve system reliability and run quality.
* Explain difficult or sensitive technical concepts to non-technical partners and collaborate across teams to align on requirements, architecture, and implementation approaches.
* Offer guidance and informal mentorship to junior engineers by sharing best practices, providing constructive feedback, and modeling effective problem-solving approaches.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Strong proficiency in Java for building production-grade, scalable applications and services.
* Experience developing front-end applications using JavaScript frameworks such as Angular and/or React, and back-end services using Node.js.
* Knowledge of microservices architectures, RESTful web services, and API design for high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems.
* Proficiency in object-oriented programming, design principles, and common design patterns for multi-tier web applications.
* Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of unit testing, behavioral or component testing, and continuous integration practices and tools.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Splunk, AppDynamics, New Relic, or similar platforms to support production systems.
* Ability to work effectively in agile teams, collaborate with cross-functional partners, and communicate clearly with technical and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.
* Minimum Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Years Of Experience: 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including full software development lifecycle responsibilities.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing cloud-based or cloud-native solutions using AWS or similar platforms, including managed and serverless technologies such as Docker, ECS, Lambda, or Kubernetes.
* Database design and implementation experience with both relational and NoSQL databases, such as MariaDB, DynamoDB, or MongoDB.
* Experience with QA and software analytics tools, CI/CD pipelines, and automated release management systems.
* Background in hospitality, travel, vacation ownership, licensing, or commerce-related domains.

**About the position**
----------------------

GEA is one of the world’s largest systems suppliers for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical sectors. Our portfolio includes machinery and plants as well as advanced process technology, components and comprehensive services. Used across diverse industries, they enhance the sustainability and efficiency of production processes globally. GEA Pharma Systems is part of the GEA Group and is dedicated to innovation and thereby providing durable quality through its well established brands: Aeromatic-Fielder™ and Collette™ - batch and continuous granulation, drying, pelletizing and coating; Buck® & Buck Systems™ - containment interface and contained materials handling; Courtoy™ – tablet compression ( ORAL SOLID DOSAGE) “; GEA Pharma Systems’ activities include partnering with customers to develop new products and enhance clinical effectiveness; the supply of R&D-scale and stand-alone production equipment; and the installation of complete integrated production lines.

### **Your responsibilities and tasks**

Roles And Responsibilities:

* As a Senior Automation Engineer, he/she must be able to develop independently and test the machine PLC, HMI & SCADA software. Expertise level should be more than 95%.

* Should be able to understand and review P&ID drawing along with process.

* Should be able to prepare, develop and review Functional design specifications (FDS), Software Design Specification (SDS), Device Configuration List (DCL) & Instrument Schedule list (IS), etc.

* Review Hardware Design Specification (HDS), Control panel design understanding (SLD/Electrical Drawings) including components list, PLC I/O list, cable schedule, tubing schedule etc.

* To understand combination of software design specifications and hardware design specifications.

* Perform Control panel FAT at panel supplier independently.

* To develop Software Integration Test documents and perform tests as per Software Integration Test Plans.

* Co-ordination with Automation internal team, Project team & Workshop team during equipment/machine assembly, and machine testing at workshop once machine is ready & handed over by workshop team, also workshop coordination during dispatch of machine.

* To resolve technical issues independently.

* To perform equipment/machine FAT in front of customers.

* Ready to go to Global sites for commissioning of pharma machines and can independently perform machine Operational qualification in front of customer. Traveling should not be concern.

* To support customer or Service team remotely for equipment commissioning & troubleshooting.

* Should have hands-on experience on modification the Software during testing and maintain record (Software Issue Record) for same.

* Preferably from Pharmaceutical Background.
  

Technical Skills:

* Must have knowledge of Siemens Platform for Programming in TIA portal (V12 up to V21), Simatic manager in which PLC (S7-300/S7-1200/1500) preferable and HMI Software WinCC flexible, WinCC Advanced/Professional, WinCC Classic/Explorer, etc.

* Must have hands on experience on Designing the Software from Scratch

* Should have Should have knowledge of SCADA GE iFlX (V. 6.0 and above)

* Should have experience in VBA & MS SQL, reporting tools, etc.

* Should have knowledge to understand of Control panel electrical design including components list, loop drawing, cable schedule, tubing schedule etc.

* Must have knowledge of VFDs, like Danfoss, ABB etc. along with parameter configuration as part of DCL.

* Should have knowledge of Pneumatic circuit design, review and understand.

* Should have knowledge of Field instruments like Temperature sensors, Differential pressure switch & Transmitter, Flow transmitter, Conductivity transmitter, Pressure Transmitter, Encoders, etc.

* Should have knowledge equipment guidelines: CE, UL, ATEX, & IEC standards.

* Should have knowledge of Pharma regulatory standards: USFDA 21 CFR Part 11, GMP/GAMP/GxP, EU Annex. 11, etc.

* Should have knowledge of Cybersecurity awareness: Cyber Resilience Act (CRA)

* Should have knowledge of Field Instruments & Controls components, be able to explore datasheets of sensors, configuration, test and maintain record for same

* Should have knowledge of good MS OS Skills

* Understanding customer experiences to be able to reflect customer expectations in GEA standards, processes, and tools.

* Preferably from Pharmaceutical Background.

Communications:

* Co-ordinate with Automation & Electrical team, Project team, & Workshop Assembly team.

* External communication with vendors & customers
* Approach works individually and with teams with optimism and solution-oriented Agile mindset.
  

Additional Skills:

* Knowledge of Rockwell (Allen Bradley PLC and HMI) software programming would be an advantage.

* Knowledge of GE iFiX/VBA/SQL would be an advantage.
  

Soft skills/ Personal attribute / trait::

* Excellent interpersonal & communications skills.

* Must be detailed oriented, Self-motivated & Innovation driven person

* Sense of commitment and committed to deliver

* Creative & Initiative skills for value addition.

* Positive attitude & willing to accept challenge.

* Vendor & Customer co-ordination skills

* Should have good troubleshooting & problem-solving skills.
  

Other Requirements:

* Willing to travel extensively of time commissioning & plant qualification across global (50% travelling).

* Traveling should not be concern (20-30%)

* Preferably from Pharmaceutical Background

* Possess working knowledge of MS office products & SAP

* KEY: Interest in making career with GEA. Intend to work minimum 5 years.

### **Your profile and qualifications**

Profile And Qualifications:

* Graduate Engineering (Instrumentation & control / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication Engineering)

* Total 4-5 years’ experience as an Industrial Automation and controls engineer and should have minimum 3 years’ relevant experience for the same.

* Siemens software programming (TIA portal) knowledge with S71500 series is preferable.

GEA is one of the largest suppliers for the food and beverage processing industry and a wide range of other process industries. jobs.title: Application Chemist
jobs.description:
#### ***Toshvin Analytical is a place where opportunity meets growth. We believe in providing the best quality service to our clients and in turn, helping businesses grow. We are a team of experienced professionals, looking for bright, motivated and committed individuals.***

#### ***If you are interested in a long-term career with one of the leading instrumentation companies in India, please email your CV to:*** ***careers@toshvin.com***

  

**Position :** Application Chemist

**Reports to :** RM / SM

**Location :** Bangalore

**Minimum Years of Work Experience :** 2 years

**Maximum Years of Work Experience :** 8 years

**Minimum Qualification :** B.Sc. or equivalent Graduation in Organic Chemistry or Analytical Chemistry

**Prefered Qualification :** M.Sc. Or Equivalent Postgraduation in Organic/ Analytical Chemistry or higher

**Maximum Grade in Toshvin :** M1

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in Chromato products

**Type of Work Experience Required:** Experience in GC, GCMS

**Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

* Responsible for providing post sale customer on-site application support on GC, GCMS & GCMS-MS
* Supporting customer method development / method optimisation assistance pertaining to their sample matrices
* Helping customer with method validation support , Trouble shooting of customers application issues
* Demonstrating to customers advanced software capabilities and method packages with sample matrices
* Coordinate with Principals local application lab for any support required to address any unresolved customers application requests
* Conducting application training to customers chemists for effective use and utilization of the system and software
* Preparing effective application support reports detailing activities carried out and final result achieved
* Preparing and making PowerPoint presentations as and when required to customer on application support activity carried out and result achieved

**General Success Behaviours:**

* **Accountability:** Takes ownership of tasks and responsibilities
* **Collaboration & Teamwork:** Works effectively with others across teams and departments
* **Communication:** Communicates clearly, effectively and professionally
* **Customer & Stakeholder Focus:** Understands the internal and external customer needs
* **Integrity & Ethics:** Acts honestly, maintains confidentiality and upholds company values
* **Results Orientation:** Works proactively, manages time to meet deadlines and priorities
* **Professionalism:** Upholds professional standards and represents the organisation positively
* **Organizational Awareness:** Keeps updated on the organization’s goals and industry trends

**Any specific skills/knowledge required for this position:**

* **1. Chromatography Expertise:**
* Hands-on experience in handling chromatography products such as Gas Chromatography (GC), GC with Headspace (GC-HS), Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS), and Triple Quad Mass Spectrometry (GC-MS/MS). Should be comfortable in operating, troubleshooting, and maintaining these instruments
* Should have handled & managed reasonably sized field sales team members (4 to 5 & more) and also Managers (managing their team)
* **2. Sampling Techniques:**
* Familiarity with advanced sampling techniques such as Headspace Samplers, Thermal Desorption Units, Pyrolyzers, and other front-end sample introduction systems
* **3. Analytical Methodology:**
* Proven experience in analytical method development, optimization, and validation using GC, GC-MS, and GC-MS/MS platforms. Ability to design robust methods to address complex analytical challenges and ensure reproducibility
* **4. Application Knowledge by Industry Segment:**
* Understanding of typical application workflows aligned with specific industry requirements (e.g., pharmaceuticals, food & beverages, environmental, petrochemicals, forensic, or clinical research). Should be able to translate customer requirements into analytical solutions
* **5. Regulatory Knowledge:**
* Awareness of global regulatory standards and compliance requirements such as US FDA, EPA, ICH, USP, GLP, and ISO guidelines. Prior experience in working under regulated environments would be highly desirable
* **6. Sample Preparation Techniques:**
* Well-versed with diverse sample preparation methods including extraction (liquid-liquid, solid-phase), digestion, purification, derivatization, and clean-up techniques. Understanding of how these steps impact final analytical results is essential
* **7. Additional Desirable Skills:**
* a. Ability to handle complex data analysis and interpret mass spectral information. b. Familiarity with software platforms used in GC/GC-MS/GC-MS/MS workflows. c. Strong problem-solving aptitude with innovative thinking for method troubleshooting. d. Effective technical communication skills to support customers, teams, and training sessions

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
**Imagine yourself...**

* Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
* Owning your ambition and fueling your career growth.
* Collaborating with a vibrant, diverse, global team.

Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, TraceGains, a Veralto company, connects people and information so teams can work smarter. We provide networked innovation, quality, and compliance solutions that help consumer brands reduce supply chain risk, accelerate business processes, and take control of their data.

At TraceGains, we believe “we’re in this together.” Innovation and ingenuity start with a diverse workforce and an inclusive workplace, and we encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

**Reporting to the Head of AI,** the AI Operations Engineer will deploy, operate, and continuously improve the infrastructure supporting AI applications, agentic systems, and machine learning workloads. This hands-on role combines DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps to make AI delivery repeatable, secure, observable, reliable, and cost-effective. The role is based in India and contributes to shared DevOps improvements across engineering.

**In this role, a typical day will look like:**

* Build and operate Azure infrastructure, containerized services, networking, storage, model-serving environments, and agentic workflows using infrastructure as code and reusable modules.
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for AI services, models, prompts, and configurations, including testing, evaluation gates, versioning, staged deployment, traceability, and rollback.
* Implement production observability through dashboards, logging, tracing, alerts, service-level objectives, and monitoring of reliability, quality, latency, token usage, and cost.
* Improve operational resilience by troubleshooting failures, managing quotas and rate limits, conducting load and capacity tests, validating backup and recovery procedures, and participating in incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Apply security and governance controls such as identity and access management, secrets handling, least-privilege access, tenant isolation, data-retention controls, sensitive-data protection, and audit logging.
* Provide reproducible development and evaluation environments, maintain operational documentation and runbooks, support retrieval pipelines and agent workflows, and contribute reusable DevOps tooling across engineering.

**The essential requirements of the job include:**

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, site reliability engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Hands-on experience operating production services on Microsoft Azure and deploying or supporting at least one production AI or machine learning service.
* Strong foundations in Linux, networking, containers, Git-based workflows, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD, with working proficiency in Python and familiarity with shell scripting.
* Practical experience with Terraform or Bicep, GitHub Actions or Azure Pipelines, and production monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, incident troubleshooting, and cloud cost management.
* Understanding of secure deployment practices, including identity and access management, secrets handling, tenant isolation, and sensitive-data protection, plus the ability to work independently and collaborate across AI, engineering, platform, and security teams.

**It would be a plus if you also possess:**

* Experience operating AI-enabled enterprise SaaS products or agentic applications in production, particularly on Azure.
* Experience with Kubernetes or Azure managed container services, model-serving platforms, LLM observability, evaluation pipelines, model registries, experiment tracking, or model and dataset versioning.
* Experience supporting retrieval systems, vector databases, fine-tuning pipelines, GPU workloads, enterprise data governance, or the food, beverage, and supplements industry.

**What success looks like in the first six months:**

* Deliver repeatable releases with tested rollback for assigned services.
* Establish actionable reliability, quality, and cost dashboards.
* Validate runbooks and recovery procedures.
* Deliver at least one reusable DevOps improvement adopted beyond the AI team.

**Why you’ll want to join us:**

TraceGains is a growing software company providing cloud-based new product development and compliance solutions for food, beverage, and dietary supplement companies. Our network platform digitizes documentation, automates workflows, and helps customers share information across their supply chains.

TraceGains is part of Veralto, a global family of companies united by a shared purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources™. You will work in a collaborative environment where purpose meets possibility and where your work can have an everyday impact.

The Hershey Company (NYSE: HSY) is an industry-leading snacks company known for making more moments of goodness through its iconic brands. With a strong portfolio across chocolate, confectionery, and salty snacks, Hershey delights consumers every day. Our beloved brands include Hershey’s, Reese’s, KitKat®, Dots Pretzels, Lesser Evil, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Ice Breakers, and more.

At Hershey, we are committed to making a meaningful difference in the communities where we live, work, and do business. This commitment originated with our founder, Milton Hershey, and continues to shape who we are today.

Guided by our employee value proposition, **Lead Today. Create Tomorrow,** we empower our people to drive impact now while shaping what comes next. Our **One Hershey** mindset brings teams together across functions, geographies, and businesses, enabling us to operate with speed, collaboration, and shared purpose.

The Hershey Company is proud to be recognized as a top employer in the United States, reflecting our commitment to our people, culture, and purpose.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Sr Executive - QRC leads shift-level Quality & Regulatory Compliance activities across aseptic packaging and cocoa/non-cocoa syrup manufacturing. The role ensures effective in-process controls, product quality, food safety and regulatory compliance while managing deviations, consumer complaint investigations, corrective and preventive actions, and continuous improvement initiatives. It also provides technical guidance to QRC and shop-floor teams and collaborates cross-functionally to uphold Hershey Quality and Food Safety standards.

Ensure in-process controls, product analysis, and timely escalation and disposition of quality deviations.

Identify process and product deviations and collaborate with Production, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions on root cause analysis and CAPA.

Conduct food safety, GMP, and hygiene audits and ensure timely closure of observations.

Support HACCP activities and reinforce food safety controls across processing and packaging stages.

Support regulatory compliance for food safety and packaging and sustain readiness for GFSI, Hershey Global Standards, and HALAL certification requirements.

Investigate consumer complaints, establish root causes, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

Drive continuous improvement opportunities in product quality, process control, and food safety.

Maintain accurate quality records and shift reports and communicate quality risks and actions to stakeholders.

Provide technical guidance and shift leadership to staff and worker employees and collaborate with internal and external partners on relevant best practices.

Minimum 5-6 years of experience in a food, beverage, or aseptic packaging environment, primarily in Quality and Food Safety. Graduate or postgraduate degree in Food Technology, Food Science, Food Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.

**Primary Location:** Gurugram, India

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

The Brand Manager position is a role which requires setting a strategic vision for the brand, building strong business plans through rigorous insight and then bringing those ideas to life through the year with strong collaboration across the network. The role requires working effectively with many different stakeholders, including other brand team members, extended marketing teams, SMEs, agencies, customer teams, franchise teams, innovation, R&D and commercial leadership, bottling partners as well as other cross-functional partners. As the **Manager, Marketing - Brand Thums Up** , you will play a pivotal role in defining the strategic direction and operational execution of Thums Up’s growth agenda in the INSWA (India & Southwest Asia) region. You will lead the brand's long-term marketing vision, multi-year strategic planning, and the design + implementation of annual business plans to achieve ambitious volume, revenue, and profitability goals. Thums Up is on an exciting journey with a brand restage under way & a recent innovation yet to be scaled, and you will be the architect of **Thums Up’s next chapter of explosive growth in INSWA,** leveraging strong business & consumer insights to deliver plans that drive impact and value. You will spearhead innovation as & when needed as per the strategy, drive consumer-centric solutions, and forge strong partnerships across internal and external stakeholders—propelling **Thums Up** as a brand that resonates with evolving consumer needs and fuels sustainable growth across the region.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Co-lead the multi-year **brand growth strategy** and annual business planning for Thums Up in the INSWA Operating Unit.

* Deliver against the **brand’s vision and positioning** —to capture new consumer occasions and uncover untapped opportunities, driving both volume and profit growth across beverage subcategories, packaging, and new channels.

* Build and deliver compelling consumer programs that drive demand and velocity.

* Manage and optimize brand performance, including **NSR, GP, and DME** , ensuring Thums Up achieves ambitious growth and financial targets in the region.

**Innovation & Partnership**

* Support product innovation and category expansion opportunities by closely collaborating with R&D, Supply Chain, Commercial, and Technical teams.

Partner with key stakeholders—including bottlers, agencies, and key customers—to co-create winning brand solutions, unlocking new avenues for growth.  



**Communication & Shopper Engagement**

* Develop high-impact campaigns and deliver clear briefs for agencies and vendors (creative, advertising, media, packaging design, etc.) to execute brand-building initiatives.

Analyze consumer insights and behavior to design communication strategies that shift consumer attitudes and drive enhanced connections with the brand.  



**Stakeholder Influence & Collaboration**

* Cultivate and manage strong relationships with diverse stakeholders.

Communicate & create strong buy-in across the system for business plans, address potential synergies, and negotiate across groups with varying objectives to achieve shared success.  



**Work Focus**

* Support the development and articulation of a multi-year **strategic roadmap** for Thums Up in the INSWA operating unit.

* Support the prioritization, decision-making, and alignment of cross-functional stakeholders across the value chain to ensure long-term brand and business success.

* Demonstrate the **ability to navigate organizational complexities** with a holistic, consumer-first view while delivering against real-world operational challenges and opportunities.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is required; MBA is strongly preferred.

* Minimum 5+ years of progressive experience in brand management or marketing, with a proven track record in driving sustainable growth for brands in a consumer-packaged goods (CPG) environment; beverage industry experience is strongly preferred.

* Proven experience in leading large-scale brands and implementing integrated marketing campaigns (IMX), particularly for global brands.

* Knowledge of procedures and media used to drive increased volume and brand growth, leveraging innovative growth strategies, brand positioning, brand strategy, SWOT analysis, competitive assessment, consumer segmentation, communication planning, and consumer-driven marketing campaigns.

* Strong ability to interpret and utilize syndicated data sources (e.g., Nielsen, IRI, CCT+) to drive insights-led decisions and a passion for understanding consumer behavior

Ability of managing cross-functional teams and external partners, such as creative agencies, suppliers, and bottling partners, to deliver seamless execution.  



**Communication Expectations**

* Act as a **strategic voice** and interface with both internal and external partners at the global, regional, and local levels to align on strategies, initiatives, and outcomes.

Effectively communicate complex brand and business plans, using influence to garner support from stakeholders across the Coca-Cola system and external partners.

jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

**Project Lead - Jomara International, Dubai, UAE**

Reports to: Director - Jomara International

**Job Purpose:**

The Project Lead runs JOMARA's new product development (NPD) and commercial execution projects from first idea to delivery on shelf. You will own the plan for every new product, new and seasonal packaging, supermarket planograms and trade show participation. You will coordinate internal teams, suppliers and retail partners so every launch lands on time, on budget and to JOMARA's premium standard.

**Key Accountabilities:**

New Product Development (NPD)

* Lead NPD projects end-to-end: concept, product brief, development and sampling, costing, approvals, production trial and launch.
* Run a stage-gate process with clear milestones, owners and sign-offs at each step.
* Coordinate Production, Quality, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales and Finance throughout each project.
* Make sure every product meets labelling, shelf-life, certification (organic, halal, food safety) and market import requirements.
* Track performance after launch and feed lessons into the next project.
* Forecasting and planning along with the supply chain

**Packaging Development (new and seasonal)**

* Manage new packaging and redesign projects from brief to delivered stock: agency briefing, artwork, proofs, approvals, printing and supplier lead times.
* Plan and deliver seasonal and gifting packaging (Ramadan, Eid, Hajj & Umrah, National Day, year-end and international festive seasons) on a calendar that works back from in-store dates.
* Manage packaging suppliers, minimum order quantities, costs and quality checks.
* Check artwork accuracy for each market: languages, regulatory text and barcodes.

**Planogram and In-store Execution**

* Manage Jomara planograms for supermarket partners: prepare proposals, agree them with category managers and track implementation.
* Build new listings and range changes into planograms together with Sales and merchandising teams.
* Run store checks on planogram compliance, share of shelf, pricing and visibility; report gaps and corrective actions.
* Support seasonal displays and secondary placements in store.

**Trade Show**

* Own the trade show calendar and budget (e.g. Gulfood, SIAL, Anuga and other target-market shows)
* Manage the full trade show checklist: registration, stand design and build, samples and shipments, marketing materials, logistics, travel and visas, staffing, lead capture and post-show follow-up.
* Report leads and return on investment after each show.

**Project Delivery Management and Coordination**

* Keep one project tracker covering all projects: timelines, owners, budget, risks and status.
* Run regular project meetings and prepare status updates for the Director – JOMARA International.
* Flag risks and delays early, agree fixes and escalate when needed.
* Build standard templates and checklists (NPD stage-gate, packaging critical path, trade show checklist) so delivery is repeatable.

**Key Performance Indicator**

* NPD and packaging projects delivered on time, within budget and to specification.
* Seasonal packaging in stores by the agreed date for every season.
* Planogram compliance and share of shelf in key supermarket accounts.
* Trade show checklists completed on time; leads generated and converted.
* Sales from new products versus plan.
* Stakeholder feedback on coordination and follow-through.

**Experience requirement:**

**Essential**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, Supply Chain or a related field.
* 3–5 years' experience, with at least 2 years leading cross-functional projects or programmes.
* Background in FMCG, food & beverage or consumer goods.
* Hands-on experience launching products, customers or markets (export or international expansion preferred).
* Strong skills in Excel and PowerPoint, and comfort with project management tools.
* Fluent English.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the GCC (UAE and KSA) retail and e-commerce.
* Exposure to food export compliance (labelling, certifications, import rules) worldwide.

**Skills and Competencies**

* **Structured and organised:**
  turns big goals into clear, workable plans.
* **Commercially minded:**
  understands how projects drive sales, margin and brand growth.
* **Influence without authority:**
  gets results through people across functions and partners.

  comfortable with numbers, budgets and trade-offs.

jobs.title: Manager Engineering
jobs.description:
**About Us**
talabat is the leading food and grocery delivery platform across the MENA region, serving customers in 9 countries. Our mobile apps are the primary interface for hundreds of thousands of daily orders — and the engineering behind them directly shapes how millions of people eat, shop, and experience convenience. We're part of the Delivery Hero network spanning 50+ countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
We're looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead one of our mobile engineering teams building the talabat consumer experience on iOS and Android. You'll own the delivery of features that millions of users interact with daily — from discovery and ordering to real-time tracking and payments.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role. You won't be writing code daily, but you'll be close enough to the codebase to make informed architectural decisions, unblock your engineers, and maintain high technical standards. You'll lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers and partner closely with product, design, and backend teams.
  
  
We practice eXtreme Programming (XP) principles — including pair programming, TDD, and continuous delivery. If you haven't worked in an XP environment before, that's fine — what matters is that you believe quality enables speed and you're excited to lead in this way.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead a team of 6–10 mobile engineers (iOS and Android) through planning, building, and shipping customer-facing features
* Own mobile release quality — drive testing strategy, monitor crash rates and performance metrics, and maintain release cadence
* Partner with product managers and designers to shape what gets built, balancing user impact with technical feasibility
* Make architectural decisions on mobile patterns (modularisation, dependency injection, reactive patterns, navigation architecture)
* Coach and develop engineers through regular 1:1s, pairing sessions, and career development conversations
* Manage cross-team dependencies with backend, platform, and infrastructure teams
* Contribute to mobile engineering standards and practices across talabat

**What Success Looks Like**
**By 90 days**
: You understand the mobile codebase, the team's delivery rhythm, and key stakeholder relationships. You've completed 1:1s with every team member and have a clear picture of strengths and growth areas.
  
  
**By 6 months**
: Your team is shipping incremental value consistently. You've measurably improved at least one dimension of team health — whether that's cycle time, test coverage, onboarding speed, or engineer satisfaction.
  
  
**By 12 months**
: You've shaped the technical roadmap for your area, developed at least one engineer toward their next career milestone, and established yourself as a trusted partner to product and design leadership.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**You must have**

* 6+ years of hands-on mobile engineering experience (iOS, Android, or cross-platform)
* 2+ years leading and managing mobile engineering teams (hiring, performance, career development)
* Deep understanding of mobile app architecture — you can evaluate trade-offs between native vs cross-platform, modular vs monolithic, and different state management approaches
* Experience shipping mobile apps at scale (100K+ DAU) with a focus on performance, reliability, and user experience
* Strong automated testing mindset — you believe in CI/CD for mobile and have driven testing culture in a team
* Experience with mobile release management, feature flagging, and gradual rollouts
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, iterative environment where priorities shift based on customer data

**Bonus If You Have**

* Experience with XP practices (TDD, pair/mob programming, trunk-based development)
* Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) or event-driven architecture
* Experience with Swift/SwiftUI and Kotlin/Jetpack Compose specifically
* Background in e-commerce, delivery, or marketplace mobile apps
* AWS or cloud platform experience
* Experience working across time zones or with distributed teams

**This role is for you if...**

* You get energy from growing engineers, not just shipping code
* You care about mobile craft — smooth animations, fast launch times, accessible interfaces
* You're comfortable making technical calls even when the data is incomplete
* You want to lead at a company where mobile IS the product, not an afterthought

**This role is NOT for you if...**

* You want a pure people-management role with no technical depth
* You prefer stable, slow-moving environments with long planning cycles
* You're not comfortable with pair programming or collaborative coding practices

**Additional Information**
**Your career growth path:**
Talabat Operates a Structured Career Framework With Clearly Defined Levels For Engineering Leaders. As a Mobile Engineering Manager, You'll Enter An Established Progression That Rewards Growing Impact, Strategic Ownership, And People Leadership
  
  
**Engineering Manager**
— You lead a single team, own delivery and people development, and build the engineering culture within your squad. Your direct impact is at the squad and domain level.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Manager**
— You lead multiple teams or a full domain. You set technical direction across squads, grow the next generation of managers, and own domain-level strategy with a longer planning horizon.
  
  
**Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across a tribe or multiple domains. You define technical vision, partner with senior business leaders, and are accountable for quality and delivery at scale.
  
  
**Senior Engineering Director**
— You lead engineering across multiple tribes or an entire product line. You shape company-wide technical strategy, build director-level talent, and represent engineering at the executive level.

jobs.title: Manager Culinary Development

Join our Catering team, where you will be part of an exciting business area that plays a vital role in delivering the Emirates ‘Fly Better’ experience. you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.
  
  
Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will Be**

* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.

* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

Qualification
  
  
**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**
**Qualification**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience**

* 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring North and South American cuisines, with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.

* And/or
* Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.
* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.
* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.
* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!
  
  
Salary & benefits
  
  
Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.
  
  
Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

jobs.title: Data Science Manager - Applied AI
jobs.description:
Since launching in Kuwait in 2004, talabat, the leading on-demand food and Q-commerce app for everyday deliveries, has been offering convenience and reliability to its customers. talabat’s local roots run deep, offering a real understanding of the needs of the communities we serve in eight countries across the region.

Our 6,000+ strong talabaty are on an awesome mission to spread positive vibes. We are proud to be a multi great place to work award winner.
  
  
****Job Description****
**About the Applied AI Tribe**
The Applied AI Tribe is talabat's internal AI engine, a team obsessed with turning cutting-edge AI into genuine, measurable business value. We don't build AI for its own sake. Our north star is Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**We have shipped 40+ AI products across four strategic streams:**

* Product & Tech Platform - AI capabilities embedded into talabat's core product and engineering platform.
* Business Automations - streamlined workflows that save real time and money across operations.
* Self-Serve AI Tools - empowering talabatis to build and use AI without needing to raise a ticket.
* Training & Onboarding - upskilling the tribe so every team can participate in the AI era.

Our engineering approach is built around shipping agentic AI systems at scale, with a harness-first philosophy, evaluation embedded into every product iteration, and production feedback loops that drive the roadmap.
  
  
**The Role**
As Manager, Data Scientist - AI within the Applied AI Tribe, you will lead a team of data scientists building and shipping the ML and generative AI systems that power decisions across talabat's product and business. You are equally a people leader and a technical practitioner, close enough to the work to make great technical decisions and grow your team, while owning the roadmap and delivery.
  
  
Your team's work spans the full AI lifecycle: from framing ambiguous business problems through data modelling, feature engineering, model training, deployment, and production monitoring. A significant focus will be leveraging LLMs, agentic systems, and generative AI to automate decisions, enrich data, and build intelligent experiences at scale, all measured against Net AI Value Delivered.
  
  
**What's On Your Plate?**
**People Leadership:**

* Lead, grow, and retain a team of data scientists, setting a high bar for technical quality, fostering a culture of ownership, and supporting each person's career development.
* Partner with recruiting to attract top data science and ML talent as the tribe scales.
* Mentor team members in ML best practices, agentic system design, production engineering, and stakeholder communication.
* Run effective team rituals, planning, design reviews, retrospectives, that keep the team aligned and moving with pace.

**Technical Strategy & Delivery:**

* Translate ambiguous business problems into well-scoped ML and AI solutions with clear, measurable success criteria tied to the tribe's north star.
* Own the team's technical roadmap: prioritise high-impact work across data enrichment, business automation, self-serve tooling, and agentic product features.
* Champion harness-first thinking, ensure evaluation pipelines, LLM observability, tooling, and infrastructure are in place before agent logic is built on top.
* Embed evaluation into every product iteration: golden datasets, stakeholder-aligned metrics, and weekly eval jobs that guide what gets built, fixed, or retired.
* Oversee the full ML lifecycle: data pipelines, feature engineering, model training, production deployment, serving, and monitoring.
* Drive adoption of LLMs and generative AI for data enrichment, smart content understanding, and automated decision-making at scale.
* Design and analyse experiments (A/B and multivariate) to rigorously measure model and product impact.
* Elevate ML and engineering standards across the team, improving MLOps, code quality, tooling, and internal learning programmes.

**Cross-functional Partnership:**

* Partner with product managers and business teams to identify high-value AI opportunities and shape them into the team's roadmap.
* Communicate clearly with senior stakeholders, from problem framing through to results and recommendations.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to understand data systems, build reliable data models, and ensure smooth production integration.

****Qualifications****

jobs.title: Head Chef
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose**

The Head Chef will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring consistent food quality, maintaining high standards of food presentation, managing kitchen staff, controlling food costs, and ensuring compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations.

The role requires strong culinary expertise, leadership capabilities, creativity, and the ability to manage kitchen operations efficiently while ensuring customer satisfaction and profitability.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Kitchen Operations & Food Production:**

* Oversee and manage all daily kitchen operations.
* Ensure timely preparation and delivery of food orders.
* Maintain consistency in food quality, taste, portion sizes, and presentation.
* Develop and implement standard recipes and food preparation procedures.
* Ensure all dishes are prepared according to company standards.
* Monitor kitchen workflow and ensure efficient coordination between kitchen sections.
* Introduce new dishes, seasonal menus, and innovative food concepts.
* Ensure proper utilization of kitchen equipment and facilities.

**Menu Planning & Development:**

* Develop, review, and update food menus in coordination with management.
* Create new recipes and improve existing dishes.
* Conduct food trials and tastings before introducing new menu items.
* Ensure menu pricing is aligned with food costs and profitability targets.
* Monitor food trends and introduce innovative culinary ideas.
* Ensure menu items meet customer expectations and brand standards.

**Team Management & Leadership:**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and develop kitchen employees.
* Allocate duties and responsibilities among kitchen staff.
* Prepare kitchen duty rosters and manage staff scheduling.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Conduct regular training on cooking techniques, food safety, and hygiene.
* Maintain teamwork, discipline, and a positive working environment.
* Identify training needs and support employee development.
* Ensure adequate staffing levels across all kitchen sections.

**Food Cost & Inventory Management:**

* Monitor food costs and ensure achievement of budgeted targets.
* Control food wastage, spoilage, and unnecessary expenses.
* Monitor stock levels and coordinate purchasing requirements.
* Ensure proper receiving, storage, and rotation of food items.
* Conduct regular inventory checks and stocktaking.
* Establish appropriate portion control and standard recipes.
* Coordinate with suppliers to ensure quality and competitive pricing.
* Monitor kitchen expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

**Food Safety & Hygiene:**

* Ensure strict compliance with UAE food safety regulations and applicable municipal requirements.
* Maintain high standards of kitchen cleanliness and sanitation.
* Ensure proper food handling, preparation, storage, and temperature control.
* Monitor expiry dates and implement FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
* Conduct regular kitchen hygiene and safety inspections.
* Ensure staff follow personal hygiene and grooming standards.
* Maintain food safety records and inspection documentation.
* Take immediate corrective action in case of hygiene or food safety violations.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction:**

* Conduct regular food quality checks before dishes are served.
* Ensure consistency in taste, texture, temperature, and presentation.
* Handle food-related customer complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with restaurant service teams to ensure smooth food delivery.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement necessary improvements.
* Ensure all special dietary requirements and food allergies are handled appropriately.

**Equipment & Maintenance:**

* Ensure kitchen equipment is maintained in good working condition.
* Report equipment breakdowns and coordinate timely repairs.
* Ensure proper use and handling of kitchen tools and machinery.
* Monitor kitchen safety procedures and prevent workplace accidents.
* Maintain organized storage areas and kitchen workstations.

**Administration & Reporting:**

* Prepare daily and monthly kitchen operational reports.
* Monitor food cost percentages, wastage, and inventory consumption.
* Maintain recipe cards, food costing sheets, and kitchen records.
* Report operational challenges and staffing requirements to management.
* Assist management with budgeting and operational planning.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and standard operating procedures.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Culinary Arts, Hospitality Management, or a related field preferred.
* Minimum 5–8 years of experience in professional kitchen operations.
* Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a Head Chef or Sous Chef role.
* Strong experience in menu development, food costing, and kitchen management.
* Knowledge of international cuisines and modern cooking techniques.
* Good understanding of UAE food safety regulations.
* Experience in managing and developing multicultural kitchen teams.
* Previous UAE experience is a must.
