jobs.description:
**Location: Al Rayyan Tower, Al Nahda, Sharjah(Border of Dubai & Sharjah)**

**Job Purpose:**

We are seeking a hands-on Marketing Director of Innovation, Menu & Markets to grow KFC, the biggest chicken brand in the region, across the GCC, Levant and Morocco. This role is pivotal in leading the day-to-day marketing operations and the innovation agenda for the brand across all operating markets. The role owns the innovation pipeline, the menu architecture and the end-to-end execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market, across dine-in, drive-thru and aggregator channels.

Provide advisory and center-of-excellence support to other markets as required. This includes strategic guidance during critical situations, recovery planning and support on key initiatives, such as strengthening menu and NPD plans, in collaboration with local teams.

**The right person is a true hustler: hands-on, action-oriented and relentless on execution, with a strong food palate, the ability to bring diverse stakeholders along, and a proven record of leading high-performing teams to drive operational and commercial excellence across markets.**

**Key Responsibility Areas:**

**Strategic Leadership: Future-proof the brand across Customer, Commercials, Competitiveness & Channels**

* Spot key customer and food trends early and shape brand strategy through relevant actions built into the 18-month plan that rolls into the AOP.
* Develop and execute an overarching marketing AOP that delivers on the brand’s strategic objectives across the geography.

**Market Windows & Execution Excellence: Own the local calendar, end to end**

* Own the planning and execution of locally relevant marketing windows in every market (e.g. Ramadan, Eid, National Days, summer, back-to-school and key sporting and cultural moments), tailoring offer, price and communication to each market.
* Deliver flawless, on-time launches from concept to restaurant, covering product readiness, supply, training, POS, digital and aggregator activation, and close gaps with speed and minimal escalation.
* Run a disciplined launch cadence with clear timelines, owners and post-launch reviews; read results fast, fix what is not working and scale what is.
* Maintain a strong, hands-on presence in markets and restaurants to ensure plans land as intended and learnings are captured and shared across markets.

**Stakeholder Management: Build alignment and get things done**

* Drive cross-functional collaboration with stakeholders, including but not limited to the Franchisor, country GMs and Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D, Procurement and other business units, to deliver cohesive and impactful NPD and market initiatives.
* Build strong, trust-based relationships with country leadership teams; balance regional consistency with local market needs and negotiate trade-offs to land the best outcome for the brand.
* Manage agency, supplier and aggregator partner relationships to deliver high-quality work on time and within budget.

**Menu & NPD Leadership: Bring a strong food palate to every decision**

* Own the menu strategy and architecture across core, value, premium and limited-time offers, ensuring a balanced, profitable menu tailored to each market.
* Lead the culinary innovation agenda to enhance brand love and relevance, driving customer penetration and frequency through sustainable new product platforms.
* Bring a strong, discerning food palate to product development: lead taste panels, kitchen sessions and product sign-offs with R&D and suppliers, and push for products that win on taste, quality and consistency.
* Translate local flavor preferences and culinary trends into a robust NPD pipeline that is operationally feasible and commercially viable.

**Fortify & Future-Proof Brand Connect: Modernize the brand**

* Actively guide all local market actions to embed the brand in local culture while retaining its global stature.
* Ensure brand consistency and quality across all market communication and activations.

**Digital Marketing Excellence: Build a digitally native brand, in line with the customers of the future**

* Manage and leverage the aggregator channel to maximize revenue while delivering profitability objectives.
* Design market programs that shift customers towards dine-in and drive-thru habits.

**Financial Outcomes: Deliver profitable growth**

* Continue to deliver industry-leading financial outcomes.
* Be accountable for commercial outcomes (transactions, average transaction value, sales and gross profit) for the brand in every operating country.
* Plan, monitor and adhere to resource allocation within budget, in line with Annual Operating Plan guidelines, and coach the team to do the same.
* Work with cross-functional teams to build a strong data- and learning-based marketing investment culture.

**Insights and Analytics: Role-model the use of data, while staying curious to spot trends that future-proof the brand**

* Use consumer research programs to refine the consumer model, conduct competitor analysis, track consumer habits and initiate product improvements to meet market needs.
* Leverage insights from dedicated brand analysts to inform decision-making, optimize innovation and address menu gaps.

**Team Leadership: Build an enviable, high-performing, cohesive working environment**

* Lead and manage a diverse, multi-disciplinary team across all eight operating markets: onboard, coach and mentor team members, set clear goals and hold the team accountable for delivery.
* Provide functional leadership to the team, fostering a culture of collaboration, ownership and innovation.
* Lead the brand agenda among cross-functional teams to accelerate delivery of the brand’s strategic objectives.
* Role-model Americana people practices and coach the team to build a strong talent bench.
* Be a strong advocate for the customer agenda within the KFC leadership team and a mentor for cross-functional teams.
* Be a flag bearer for Americana’s purpose, vision and strategy, instilling an ownership mindset and a bias for action.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* 10–15 years of marketing leadership experience.
* Experience in QSR or retail is a must-have.
* Proven track record of managing marketing for multi-country, multi-channel portfolios in complex, high-transaction environments such as KFC or other global brands.
* Demonstrated success in owning and executing locally relevant campaigns and seasonal windows across multiple markets, on time and to a high standard.
* A strong food palate and genuine passion for food, with hands-on experience in menu management, NPD and product sign-off.
* Expertise in building brand love to drive both customer penetration and frequency.
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align senior leaders, the franchisor, country teams and cross-functional partners.
* A hustler mindset: hands-on, resourceful, comfortable with ambiguity and driven to get things done at pace.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset with the ability to interpret and act on data insights.
* Exceptional leadership and team management skills, with a proven ability to build future leaders while driving performance in cross-functional teams.

This team is responsible for a wide range of food and non-food functions, including catering, equipment, and amenities for inflight dining and special events.

If you are passionate about culinary excellence, logistics, and delivering world-class service, we invite you to apply and contribute to the success of Emirates Group. As a key part of our Service Delivery operations, our catering team makes crucial decisions that enhance the customer experience and elevate our growing global brand.

As a **Manager Culinary Development,** you will manage the recipe, dish and menu design process to ensure Emirates remains at the forefront of global culinary trends and innovation. You will lead a centralised Culinary Development Centre of Excellence, responsible for creating, maintaining and governing the Emirates recipe bank. Working in collaboration with key stakeholders and leveraging customer insights and data, you will plan and develop network-wide menus that consistently delight our guests.

Additionally, you will plan and deliver Dubai-based culinary workshops focused on educating Emirates' global inflight and premium lounge catering partners on menu and dish preparation. In addition, you will oversee Emirates-owned food and beverage products, while developing and managing Emirates-nominated food suppliers to ensure the highest standards of quality, consistency and culinary excellence across the network. We are hiring for two distinct roles, each requiring specialist expertise in either North and South American cuisine development and innovation, or the development, standardisation and management of Special Meals (SPMLs), including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals.

**In this role, you will be:**

* Accountable for the planning and day to day management of the EK Culinary Centre of Excellence ensuring that annual targets of blue-sky cuisine innovations and individual dish creations are exceeded.
* In collaboration with the Service design team, responsible for supporting the decision making for flight/cabin level meal service standards.
* Accountable for the creation and development of detailed recipes that are conducive to performing optimally in the EK, network wide catering partner facilities.
* Responsible for documenting and version controlling all EK recipes and production methods in the EK owned, catering management system.
* In collaboration with the Regional Catering Management and Business Insights teams, accountable for station level menu planning ensuring customers’ expectations are exceeded.
* Accountable for planning and executing regular Dubai based, global inflight supplier culinary workshops to ensure that the education of individual dish and menu creations are understood and consistently translated around the EK network.
* Accountable for the product development life cycle management of EK owned, category specific, food and beverage items.
* Accountable for developing the EK centralised, nominated food and beverage suppliers to ensure that we are able to constantly improve our speed to market and efficiency gains.
* Responsible for identifying and developing food and beverage promotional and celebratory initiatives to effectively promote and market EKs award winning offering.
* Responsible for carrying out regular industry benchmarking across all hospitality sectors to ensure that EK remains at the forefront of food and beverage innovation.

##### **Qualification**

**To be considered for this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

**Qualification:**

* An attested degree (12+3) or equivalent work experience.
* Culinary apprenticeship is preferred.

**Experience:**

* + 10+ years in culinary development, fine dining, hospitality R&D, or large-scale production. Airline catering experience preferred.
  + Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation and standardisation of menus and recipes featuring **North and South American cuisines** , with in-depth knowledge of regional culinary traditions, authentic cooking techniques, emerging food trends, ingredient selection, nutritional principles, portion control and cost optimisation, ensuring culinary authenticity, consistency and alignment with diverse passenger preferences.
* **And/or**

  + Demonstrated expertise in the development, innovation, standardisation and management of **Special Meals (SPMLs),** including Child, Medical, Religious and Allergen-Sensitive Meals, supported by sound knowledge of nutrition, dietary principles, menu engineering, allergen management and religious and cultural food requirements, ensuring nutritional suitability, recipe consistency and alignment with diverse passenger needs.

**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Comprehensive knowledge of and passion for, global cuisines, emerging culinary trends, and evolving guest preferences.

* Deep expertise in recipe development, standardisation, and large-scale recipe upscaling.
* Strong understanding of airline catering operations, including large-scale production, cook-chill processes, and the associated operational challenges and considerations.

* Proven ability to train, coach and educate colleagues and external catering partners on recipe execution and individual dish preparation.

* Confident and engaging presenter, with the ability to communicate with credibility and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.
* Highly organised with strong planning, prioritisation, and project management capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to perform effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities within tight timeframes.

At Emirates, we're committed to providing our employees with opportunities to grow and develop in their careers. So if you're looking for a challenging and rewarding opportunity, apply today and join our team!

##### **Salary & benefits**

Join us in a management role and enjoy an attractive tax-free salary. On top of our generous travel benefits, including discounted flights and hotel stays around the world, this managerial role also offers an excellent leave and healthcare package. That's in addition to transport benefits, life insurance and much more.

Discover what it's like to live and work in our fast-paced, cosmopolitan home city of Dubai and build a rewarding career with Emirates!

jobs.title: Manager, Nutrition, Health and Wellness

POSITION VACANCY

Manager Nutrition Health & Wellness

POSITION SNAPSHOT

Company: Nestlé

Location: Dubai - HQ

POSITION SUMMARY

Joining Nestlé means you are joining the largest food and Beverage Company in the world. At our very core, we are a human environment – passionate people driven by the purpose of enhancing the quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.

As the Manager Nutrition, Health & Wellness, you will work across the MENA region and across the full Nestlé portfolio, bringing nutrition science, portfolio insights and local market understanding together to strengthen products, claims and consumer communication. You will also be responsible to apply findings of research, dietary guidelines, relevant population trends, nutritional needs & wants into innovations of nutrition products & digital initiatives; drive continuous improvement of Nestlé products by applying product nutrient profiles and quality criteria in context of population diet, guide products nutrition and health benefits, credible brand communications and stories.. In addition you will also be responsible of building nutrition capability across cross-functional teams to help our brands deliver better choices and enable Nestlé’s Purpose.

A DAY IN THE LIFE …

* Inspire nutrition, dietary & dietetics dimensions into business category strategy. Interpret/evaluate available knowledge and nutrition science to guide business partners and product developers.

* Define desired nutritional profile for target population. Consideration of product as part of a diet, define product 's nutritional composition, its nutrition value & measures (criteria, thresholds, scores), lead nutritional assessment to achieve nutritional superiority. Validate final product’s nutritional criteria & composition.

* Identify nutrition gaps & opportunities for portfolio evolution & growth. Understands and articulates the nutrition reality to drive the identification of nutritional needs and gaps in portfolio. Collation of nutrition science, nutrition landscaping, knowledge on key insights from consumer data, competitive analysis, and global and local trends, translate relevant nutrition knowledge into competitive and feasible product concepts and solutions.

* Acts as the local nutrition partner to local marketing teams, translating portfolio, competitive, consumer and scientific insights into nutrition recommendations supporting category and brand priorities. Liaising with cross-functional teams and global Nestlé innovation and R&D centers.

* Provide substantiation behind nutrition or health claims development. Deploy nutrition and health claims positively evaluated by scientific authorities and /or by Nestlé Health Claim Panel in line with business and brand strategy, guide claims within I/R process. Develop scientific substantiation for market driven nutrition & health claims: e.g. write a scientific rationale document for health claims to be evaluated by global strategic teams & Nestlé Health Claims Panel.

* Brings science-based nutrition insights to inspire innovation and build credible, compelling communication stories.

* Trains and engages market employees and marketers on nutrition and contributes to the internal capability agenda and the Nutritionists Community.

* External KOL/ authorities engagement. May represent the organization at different nutrition forums and convenings, including food industry/technical working groups. Content provider and/or a spoke-person for nutritional advocacy topics externally for categories of responsibility. Acts as a key nutrition advisor at any level and understand the areas of opportunities of positive impact and risks within the external nutrition environment, the Food Industry and Public Health environment

What will make you successful…

* University Degree; Masters in Nutrition/Dietetics, Food science and technology with nutrition specialization)

* 2–5 years of experience as a nutritionist in the food industry, public health or an academic environment.

* Experience in translating nutrition science into product, communication or consumer applications.

* Experience in nutritional portfolio analysis, data interpretation or competitive benchmarking is an asset.

* Experience with local nutrition regulations, claims and labelling.

* Experience in training or communicating nutrition topics to non-expert audiences.

* Exposure to cross-functional business environments (Marketing, R&D, Regulatory) is a strong asset.

* Project management skils and ability to work in matrix organizations.

* Fluency in Arabic is required; proficiency in French is an advantage.

The role also guarantees that local APMEA West insights and evidence reach the distributed Scientific Affairs & CORA group.

jobs.title: Technical Service and Nutrionist
jobs.description:
**Interested in a career that matters?**
At Novonesis, we believe solutions rooted in biology can help solve some of the world’s biggest challenges. In this role, you will bring deep animal nutrition expertise together with regional technical leadership to help customers across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA) turn science and data into practical solutions.
  
  
**The role & your impact**
As Technical Service Specialist & Nutritionist, you will be the single regional owner for technical planning across MEIA, covering all three subregions.
  
  
You will translate commercial priorities and customer needs into disciplined technical plans, coordinate structured customer trials and registration support, mobilize specialist technical-service resources, and accelerate the resolution of advanced customer requirements.
  
  
You will also lead the establishment and continuous development of regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing and service laboratories. Your work will help strengthen customer support, improve the quality and reuse of technical evidence, and accelerate evidence-based adoption of Animal Biosolutions across MEIA.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities In This Role**

* Own and actively manage an integrated technical-service plan across all three MEIA subregions, aligned with commercial priorities, product strategies and customer needs.
* Maintain visibility of technical projects, trials, registrations, capability-building initiatives, priorities, dependencies and resource requirements.
* Establish consistent ways of working, decision criteria, documentation standards and review routines across the subregions.
* Identify capability gaps and determine where regional expertise, external partners or global specialist support should be deployed.
* Design and coordinate customer trials with clear hypotheses, protocols, success criteria, responsibilities, timelines and data requirements.
* Ensure trial plans reflect customer production systems, feed materials, animal species, formulation practices and relevant local conditions.
* Guide data collection, analysis, interpretation and technical reporting to deliver credible, reproducible and decision-ready outcomes.
* Translate trial learning into reusable protocols, technical arguments, case studies and regional best practices.
* Coordinate technical inputs for product registrations in partnership with Regulatory Affairs and relevant internal experts.
* Connect customer and market requirements with the appropriate subject-matter experts, laboratories, application teams and global technical-service resources.
* Act as the regional focal point for complex or high-value technical customer requirements that go beyond routine local support.
* Triage technical escalations and lead root-cause assessment and resolution planning for advanced nutrition, feed-performance and application issues.
* Define the roadmap for regional technical capabilities, including feed-analysis testing, service laboratories, methods, equipment, partners and competencies.
* Lead the setup, qualification and continuous improvement of regional testing and service-laboratory capabilities in line with applicable quality, safety and compliance requirements.
* Establish appropriate test methods, sample-handling practices, data-integrity expectations, reporting standards and service levels.
* Build a practical network of internal and external laboratories to provide timely and reliable analytical support across MEIA.
* Provide expert guidance on animal nutrition, feed matrices, formulation principles, ingredient variability and the use of feed-formulation software.
* Build technical capability within sales and technical teams through coaching, training, field support and reusable technical tools.
* Monitor relevant technical, scientific, competitive and market developments and translate them into implications for the regional business.

**What You'll Need To Be Successful In This Role**

* A degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Typically 10–15 years of relevant experience in the Animal Health and Nutrition industry, with substantial exposure to technical service, animal nutrition, feed applications or related work.
* Strong knowledge of animal nutrition, feed ingredients, nutrient specifications, feed matrices and formulation principles.
* Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured commercial or research trials and translating results into customer recommendations.
* Practical experience with feed analysis, laboratory services, analytical methods and interpretation of nutritional data.
* Proficiency with feed-formulation software, including the ability to interpret formulation outputs, constraints and economic trade-offs.
* Ability to develop trial protocols, evaluate data quality, interpret results and prepare clear technical reports.
* Understanding of feed-analysis testing, sample management, laboratory methods and quality expectations.
* Ability to diagnose complex customer requirements and coordinate specialist support across organizational boundaries.
* Strong planning, prioritization and project-management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem solving and sound judgment, including when working under time pressure.
* Clear and credible communication with technical experts, commercial teams, senior stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to work collaboratively and build trust across functions, cultures and geographies in a matrix organization.
* Fluency in English.
* Willingness and ability to travel across MEIA in line with business needs.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**

* An advanced degree in Animal Nutrition, Animal Science, Veterinary Science, Feed Science or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting product registrations, regulatory technical documentation or cross-functional registration projects.
* Experience working across culturally and commercially diverse markets within MEIA.
* Additional languages relevant to the MEIA region.

**What We Offer You**
You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of science, customer needs and commercial priorities across a diverse international region.
  
  
The role offers extensive collaboration with regional and subregional Sales, Marketing and Business Development teams as well as Technical Service, R&D, Application, Laboratory, Product Management, Regulatory Affairs and Quality colleagues.
  
  
As a regional individual contributor, you will have significant ownership of how technical expertise, evidence and capabilities are coordinated and shared across MEIA, with opportunities to build knowledge, strengthen ways of working and contribute directly to customer outcomes.
  
  
**Working conditions**

* Primary location: Türkiye.
* Secondary location: Dubai.
* Hybrid work mode.
* Regional scope covering all three MEIA subregions.
* Travel requirement: approximately 40–50% across MEIA, in line with business needs.

**Relevant information**
This is an individual contributor position within Technical Service / Animal Nutrition, with responsibility across Middle East, India & Africa (MEIA).
  
  
**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

jobs.description:
Home to some of the UAE’s best-loved brands, including Lacnor, Laban Up, Oasis, Milco and Safa, NFPC is looking for a
**Quality Technologist**
to join our Quality team.

**JOB PURPOSE**

The Quality Technologist ensures that Fresh and UHT products meet the highest standards of quality, safety, and regulatory compliance. They analyze product samples and run routine tests, including pH, conductivity, and the concentration of chemicals used, and they assess packaging materials. They also apply hygiene best practices across operations, carry out internal audits, and keep accurate quality records. Working within the quality team, they implement and maintain quality standards, procedures, and systems that meet UAE regulatory requirements and support consistent product quality.

**ESSENTIAL ACCOUNTABILITIES, RESPONSIBILITIES AND KPIs**

**Testing & Analysis**

* Perform physical, chemical, and microbiological tests on raw milk, ingredients, and finished dairy products, including fat, protein, titratable acidity, pH, moisture, and microbiological counts.
* Carry out environmental and allergen swabbing to verify sanitation effectiveness.
* Test packaging integrity and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for corrective action.

**Process Control**

* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters across pasteurisation, fermentation, filling, and packaging. Make sure CCPs stay within defined limits and escalate deviations to the line supervisor for immediate corrective action.

**Raw & Packaging Materials**

* Inspect incoming raw and packaging materials in line with the company’s raw material receiving programme. Prepare summary reports on supplier ratings and material disposition.
* Take part in qualifying new ingredients, raw materials, and packaging materials, including machine runnability, stability testing, and pre-commercial and commercial trials.
* Lead the closure of packaging-related Non-Conformance Action Reports (NCARs), including reviewing and validating suppliers’ corrective and preventive actions.

**Compliance & Audits**

* Ensure compliance with HACCP, ISO, FSSC 22000, and other food safety and quality management systems.
* Implement Food Safety and Quality Assurance (FSQA) procedures across manufacturing and supply chain functions to reduce food safety risks.
* Support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and maintain accurate quality documentation.

**SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Dairy Technology, or a related field.
* 2+ years of quality assurance or quality control experience, preferably in dairy or juice manufacturing.
* HACCP Level 3 certification.

M42’s Integrated Health Solutions (IHS) platform drives transformative national programs and population health initiatives, addressing global health challenges through precision, prevention, and predictive care. Environmental Sciences complements these efforts by analyzing non-human factors affecting public health. IROS (Integrated Research Organization Solutions) supports innovation through high-quality clinical research, reinforcing M42’s commitment to a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  
We are seeking a Medical Laboratory Technologist to join our Clinical Genomics team. This role involves performing a range of laboratory procedures to support the analysis of clinical specimens, under the supervision of the Genomics Laboratory Supervisor. The successful candidate will contribute to the preparation, processing, and analysis of samples using molecular biology and genomic techniques, helping to ensure timely and accurate test results.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Adhere to laboratory policies and comply with applicable regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Perform manual and automated extraction and purification of DNA/RNA from clinical specimens (e.g., blood, tissue, bone marrow).
* Prepare DNA libraries and utilize sequencing platforms for basic genomic analysis.
* Operate and troubleshoot Next Generation Sequencing (NGS) equipment.
* Conduct PCR, Sanger sequencing, and MLPA testing.
* Perform QA/QC procedures, maintain accurate documentation, and troubleshoot technical issues.
* Participate in validation activities, instrument setup, and daily lab operations.

* Build and optimize automated workflows for sequencing quality control, alignment, variant calling, annotation, and downstream genomic analyses.

* Support harmonization of genomic data across sequencing platforms, software versions, pipelines, callers, and data releases.
* Apply best practices in genomic quality control, including assessment of sequencing metrics, sample integrity, contamination, variant quality, batch effects, and cohort release criteria.

* Collaborate with scientists, bioinformaticians, software engineers, platform teams, cloud specialists, and data management teams to deliver technical and scientific objectives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of production genomics workflows and operational processes.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, data governance requirements, confidentiality standards, and applicable regulatory frameworks.
* Document workflows, technical processes, and validation activities to support reproducibility and operational excellence.

**Qualifications**

* PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.

At OMS Pharma, we believe the next generation of pharmaceutical innovation will be shaped by artificial intelligence, computational biology and advanced scientific research.

We are developing an ambitious vision to bring together AI, molecular sciences and advanced computing to explore new approaches to medicine discovery, drug development and biological simulation.

As we develop our research capabilities, we are seeking an AI Scientist – Drug Discovery & Computational Biology interested in contributing to innovative research at the intersection of technology and medicine.

1. AI-Powered Drug Discovery

Explore machine-learning and generative AI models for molecular discovery.

Develop computational approaches to identify and evaluate potential drug candidates.

Research predictive methods for drug properties, efficacy and safety.

Work with molecular docking, virtual screening and protein–ligand interactions.

Explore QSAR, ADMET and molecular property prediction.

Investigate AI-assisted molecular optimization.

Investigate computational representations of human biological systems.

Explore AI models for predicting molecular and biological responses.

Contribute to research on virtual biological simulations and personalized medicine.

4. AI Models & Scientific Computing

Develop machine-learning and deep-learning workflows for scientific research.

Explore applications of large language models and generative AI in pharmaceutical research.

Work with biological, chemical and pharmaceutical datasets.

5. Research & Innovation

Review emerging scientific technologies and published research.

Develop and evaluate computational prototypes.

Collaborate across AI, pharmaceutical sciences and computational biology.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

* We welcome researchers and professionals from diverse scientific backgrounds, including:

* Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning

* Computational Biology & Bioinformatics

* Computational Chemistry & Medicinal Chemistry

* Pharmaceutical Sciences & Biotechnology

* Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow

* Molecular docking and molecular dynamics

* Generative AI and graph neural networks

OMS Pharma aims to connect advanced artificial intelligence with pharmaceutical sciences and computational research.

We value curiosity, scientific rigor, creativity and the ability to transform ambitious research ideas into testable computational models.

OMS Pharma

Exploring the Future of Medicine Through Artificial Intelligence.

The resort will offer 1,530 rooms and suites, 22 restaurants, lounges, and bars, a theater, and a beach club. * Diploma or degree in Hospitality Management, Business, Law, or Public Administration; compliance or food ‑ safety certifications a plus (e.g., HACCP).
* Fluent English: Arabic or an additional language is an advantage.

**About Wynn Al Marjan Island’s Benefits**
We offer an attractive salary, paid in Dirhams (AED), the local currency of the UAE. In addition, we offer an excellent leave policy, a healthcare package and as well as life insurance, incentive programs, and other employee benefits. The result is a package that makes this role highly attractive to outstanding applicants seeking a career with Wynn Resorts, among the most renowned and celebrated brands in the global hospitality industry.

jobs.title: Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance
jobs.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance based in United Arab Emirates.**
We are looking for a Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance to oversee supplier quality, food safety, and regulatory compliance across a network of ingredient suppliers, manufacturing partners, and fulfillment facilities. You will own the quality systems and processes that ensure materials and finished products consistently meet established standards. Working closely with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain, you will lead supplier qualification, audits, risk assessments, and corrective action programs. You will also manage ingredient verification, quality documentation, and supplier performance monitoring to identify and address potential issues proactively. This role combines hands-on quality oversight with strategic supplier partnerships and continuous improvement initiatives. You will contribute to a collaborative, fast-moving environment where product integrity, accountability, and consumer trust are essential.
  
  
**Accountabilities**
As Quality Manager, Vendor Compliance, you will take ownership of supplier quality programs and the systems used to maintain food safety, regulatory compliance, and reliable manufacturing standards. You will work across internal teams and external partners to identify risks, resolve quality issues, strengthen supplier performance, and ensure documentation remains accurate and audit-ready.
  
  

* Supplier Quality & Compliance

+ Own supplier qualification, approval, and compliance programs, ensuring suppliers and materials meet quality, food safety, regulatory, and business requirements.
+ Lead supplier and material onboarding in partnership with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, and Supply Chain.
+ Establish and maintain risk-based supplier and ingredient assessments based on material risk, manufacturing processes, supplier performance, and historical quality data.
+ Lead supplier quality investigations, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and escalations, ensuring root causes are identified and corrective actions are sustainable.
+ Ensure suppliers comply with established requirements, including supplier expectation guidelines, specifications, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
+ Lead supplier audits and facility assessments while driving continuous improvement through effective supplier partnerships.

* Ingredient Quality Management

+ Manage the ingredient positive release program, including certificate of analysis (COA) reviews, material disposition, and communication with warehouses and internal stakeholders.
+ Establish risk-based ingredient testing and verification programs to confirm materials meet quality and food safety specifications.
+ Oversee ingredient retention sample and traceability programs to support investigations and supplier performance evaluations.
+ Lead ingredient nonconformance investigations and coordinate appropriate supplier corrective actions and material disposition.
+ Monitor ingredient quality trends and variability to identify and mitigate emerging risks.

* Quality Systems & Document Control

+ Own document control processes for Quality and Supply Chain documentation, including SOPs, forms, specifications, and work instructions.
+ Establish standards for document creation, review, approval, version control, archiving, and retention.
+ Ensure supplier compliance records remain complete, current, and audit-ready.
+ Coordinate periodic document reviews with cross-functional process owners to ensure procedures reflect current practices and requirements.
+ Continuously improve quality systems and documentation processes to strengthen compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency.

* Supplier Performance & Continuous Improvement

+ Develop and manage supplier performance metrics and scorecards to track quality, compliance, recurring issues, and emerging risks.
+ Establish supplier performance review and escalation processes, including improvement plans for high-risk or underperforming suppliers.
+ Analyze supplier and ingredient quality trends to identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
+ Partner with Procurement and Supply Chain leadership on supplier approval, performance management, escalation, and disqualification decisions.
+ Provide leadership with visibility into supplier quality risks, significant nonconformances, and outstanding corrective actions.

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate has 6–8+ years of Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality experience in the food and beverage industry, preferably within beverage manufacturing. You bring strong technical knowledge of food safety systems and supplier compliance, combined with the ability to manage investigations, audits, and corrective action programs. You are analytical, organized, and comfortable influencing external suppliers and internal stakeholders while managing competing priorities.
  
  

* 6–8+ years of experience in Quality Assurance or Supplier Quality within the food and beverage industry; beverage experience is preferred.
* 0–2 years of experience managing and developing technical team members.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier qualification, approval, compliance, and risk assessment programs.
* Strong experience conducting supplier audits, managing quality investigations, and implementing CAPAs.
* Thorough knowledge of food safety and quality systems, including:

+ Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs).
+ HACCP and Preventive Controls.
+ Global Food Safety Initiative (GFSI) standards.
+ FDA and Food Safety Modernization Act (FSMA) requirements.

* Experience managing supplier onboarding, approval, and compliance documentation through platforms such as TraceGains, FoodLogiQ, or FoodChain ID, keeping certificates, audits, and specifications current and audit-ready.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills and experience analyzing quality data and supplier performance metrics.
* Excellent organizational and analytical abilities, with strong attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive supplier accountability.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and promote continuous improvement.
* A collaborative mindset and commitment to professional values such as humility, aspiration, integrity, accountability, and empathy.

**Benefits**

* Annual compensation of $120,000–$135,000, plus bonus.
* Remote working arrangement.
* Opportunity to take ownership of supplier quality and compliance programs across manufacturing and supply chain partners.
* Cross-functional collaboration with Procurement, Regulatory, R&D, Supply Chain, and Quality teams.
* Opportunity to drive continuous improvement and strengthen quality systems in a growing consumer products environment.
* Collaborative culture that values transparency, thoughtful feedback, initiative, and professional development.
* Commitment to providing reasonable accommodations during the application process and employment.

jobs.description:
Agriculture Subsidy Redesign, Targeting, and Impact

**Role purpose**

Design and implement subsidies and incentive mechanisms that improve productivity, sustainability, and farmer livelihoods while ensuring
**fiscal sustainability, compliance, and measurable impact**
. This role is a technical lead within the TMO portfolio and owns the end-to-end subsidy reform workstream.

**Responsibilities:**

**Diagnosis and design**

* Map existing subsidy landscape: eligibility, spend, leakage risks,incentive distortions, overlaps.
* Segment beneficiaries (farm types, size,crop/livestock systems, geography, vulnerability).
* Design alternative subsidy models:
* Targeted input subsidies (seed/feed/fertilizer) with controls
* Outcome/conditionality-linked incentives (water efficiency, compliance, productivity)
* Capital grants/ co-investment schemesfor modernization (irrigation, greenhouses, renewables)
* Develop fiscalscenarios and trade-offs for government decision-makers.

**Targeting, eligibility, and controls**

* Define eligibility rules, verification methods,and audit trails(registry integration, land/farm ID, production evidence).
* Design leakageprevention controls (claimsvalidation, supplier vetting,anomaly detection triggers).
* Develop compliance mechanisms and enforcement pathways aligned with regulations.
* Develop cost-benefit scenarios to define and review on an ongoing basis applicability of the subsidies.

**Implementation of architecture**

* Translate designinto executable implementation plan: policy drafts,operating procedures, system requirements, vendor/process changes.
* Work with digital/data teamson:
* Farmer registryintegration
* e-voucher / digital disbursement logic
* Case management workflows for exceptions and appeals
* Support procurement packages (system integrators, payment rails, verification services).

**Monitoring and impactevaluation framework**

* Define an impact evaluation approach:
* Logic models(inputs → outputs→ outcomes)
* Baselines and measurement methods(surveys, remote sensingproxies, administrative data)
* Quasi-experimental designoptions were feasible(phased rollout, comparison groups)
* Establish a benefits trackingdiscipline within the TMO (impactreporting cadence, auditability).

**Stakeholder management**

* Coordinate with finance/treasury, audit,regulators, farmer associations, suppliers, and service providers.
* Develop communication materials to supportadoption and managepolitical economic risks.

**Required experience and qualifications.**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in economics, public policy, agricultural economics, or related.Advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years in agricultural subsidy/incentives, social supporttargeting, agri-policy implementation, or development programs at leading organization.
* Demonstrated experience designing and implementing targeting and payment/disbursement mechanisms (public sector preferred).
* Strong quantitative capability: fiscal modeling,program evaluation methods.
* Familiarity with global best practices (FAO, World Bank, IFAD style program disciplines) preferred.

jobs.title: Regulatory Affairs Manager
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
**About Fanatics Momentum**
Fanatics Momentum is building the UAE's leading regulated commercial gaming operator. Licensed by the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority (GCGRA), we operate across lottery, iGaming, sportsbook, and digital content, combining Momentum's regional foundation with Fanatics' global product, technology, and scale. The business is ambitious, well-resourced, and moving fast. If you want to help build a category-defining operator in one of the world's most exciting regulated gaming markets, this is the right time to join.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Regulatory Affairs Manager supports the Regulatory Compliance function across the Group’s lottery and commercial gaming operations. The role is primarily responsible for preparing regulatory submissions, managing regulatory engagement and providing practical regulatory advice to support business initiatives.
  
  
In addition, the role contributes to ongoing regulatory compliance activities, including reporting, governance processes, updates to policies and procedures, regulatory tracking and horizon scanning.
  
  
The Regulatory Affairs Manager will act as key regulatory contact and support submissions and advisory work across the broader Commercial Gaming business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Regulatory Affairs Manager will report to the Head of Regulatory Compliance. Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Regulatory Submissions & Engagement
* Engage with GCGRA on regulatory submissions, queries and approvals, including preparing responses and supporting regulatory discussions.
* Lead preparation of regulatory submissions to GCGRA, including product approvals, internal control updates, waiver requests and formal notifications.
* Draft and coordinate responses to regulatory information requests and queries.
* Manage regulatory timelines, dependencies and submission documentation.
* Support and contribute to regulatory meetings and engagements.
* Regulatory Advice
* Provide practical regulatory advice to support product development, technology changes and commercial initiatives.
* Identify regulatory approval requirements and timing considerations early in project lifecycles.
* Translate regulatory requirements into clear guidance for Product, Technology, Operations and Commercial teams.
* Escalate material regulatory risks appropriately.
* Business Partnering
* Act as a key regulatory contact for the Commercial Gaming team.
* Work closely with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure initiatives are structured in a regulatorily compliant manner.
* Work with internal stakeholders to ensure regulatory requirements are correctly implemented in products and processes.
* Regulatory Governance & Team Operations
* Contribute to regulatory oversight activities across both Business Units.
* Support preparation of regulatory reporting, management updates and Board-level reporting.
* Provide regulatory advice and review in relation to business-owned policies and procedures, particularly where regulatory submissions or product changes require updates.
* Support investigations into regulatory incidents or potential non-compliance matters.
* Track regulatory actions, commitments and supervisory items through to completion.
* Contribute to horizon scanning and assessment of regulatory developments and their impact on the business.
* Contribute to the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of Regulatory Compliance team processes, templates and operating standards.
* Support the ongoing enhancement of compliance processes and systems to ensure effective team delivery.
* Maintain the highest standards of professional and ethical conduct at all times.

**Requirements**

* Experience preparing regulatory submissions and formal responses to regulators.
* Strong experience interpreting and applying regulatory frameworks in a commercial context.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex regulatory approval processes end to end.
* Experience drafting structured regulatory advice to support business initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
* Experience and proficiency in understanding, interpreting and implementing legislative and regulatory requirements.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to engage confidently with stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills, both written and spoken, with the ability to prepare clear, persuasive submissions.
* Strong organisational skills and ability to manage competing deadlines.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in regulatory compliance or regulatory advisory roles.
* Experience in gaming, lottery, financial services or other regulated sectors preferred.
* Ideally a degree in Business, Risk Management, Law or other relevant field.

At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. We value diversity, collaboration, and innovation, and we’re committed to creating an environment where every team member can thrive. If you’re ready to grow your career and help us build Momentum, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.description:
**Location: Northeast**

**Territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI**

If you are interested in the below position, please send your resume to careers@tgtxinc.com and REFERENCE THE POSITION TITLE within the subject line.

Organizational Overview

TG Therapeutics is a fully integrated, commercial stage, biotechnology company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of novel treatments for B-cell diseases. In addition to a research pipeline including several investigational medicines, TG Therapeutics has received approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for BRIUMVI® (ublituximab-xiiy) for the treatment of adult patients with relapsing forms of multiple sclerosis, including clinically isolated syndrome, relapsing-remitting disease, and active secondary progressive disease, as well as approval by several foreign nations for BRIUMVI to treat adult patients with RMS who have active disease defined by clinical or imaging features. For more information, visit www.TGTherapeutics.com.

Role

The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based regional Medical Affairs professional responsible for developing and enhancing relationships with medical professionals, researchers, clinical trial support staff, advocacy, and other members of the Myasthenia Gravis (MG) scientific and clinical community. Additionally, the MSL will demonstrate scientific, clinical, and therapeutic area expertise during scientific engagements with key opinion leaders (KOLs) and other healthcare professionals (HCPs) and requires credibility to engage top national and regional thought leaders.

Reporting into the MSL Team Field Director, the MSL is a critical role in TG Therapeutics’ customer-facing field model, collaborating compliantly with cross-functional teams including Clinical Development, Sales, Marketing, and Market Access to provide clinical support and education.

This role will cover the following territory: ME, VT, NH, CT, MA, NY, PA, NJ, MD, DE, RI

Key Responsibilities

* Be a credible medical/scientific expert
* Fair-balanced scientific engagement across the assigned geography; establishes and maintains relationships with KOLs, HCPs, clinics and institutions, payers, and other stakeholders within the MG area
* Responsive and engages regularly with thought leaders and external stakeholders
* Collaborate and support Clinical Development and Clinical Operations research initiatives including site identification and trial recruitment
* Partner with clinical trial sites to optimize patient recruitment strategies, leveraging both data-driven insights and relationship-building
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, and Medical Affairs—to troubleshoot recruitment challenges and streamline processes
* Monitor site performance metrics and provide actionable recommendations to improve enrollment rates.
* Support investigator meetings, site initiation visits, and ongoing trial communications
* Maintain compliance with all regulatory requirements and company SOPs while fostering trust and transparency with stakeholders
* Supports Medical Affairs initiatives (advisory board meetings) and informs medical strategy through capturing and reporting of medical insights
* Keeps current on disease state, therapeutic landscape, and competitor data and records insights
* Utilize effective, confident, and professional communications to establish strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders
* Respond to and documents unsolicited medical requests (MIRs) for information in a timely manner
* Support Market Access by educating payers (Health plans and state Medicaids) and key decision makers (Pharmacists and P&T Committees) on the clinical efficacy and safety profile to support formulary decisions
* Liaise unsolicited submissions and information for investigator-initiated trials (IITs) between the investigator and home office Medical Affairs
* Lead and/or participate in special projects or initiatives aligned to US Medical strategy and objectives
* Maintain accurate reporting and documentation of MSL activities

Professional Experience/Qualifications

* A scientific or clinical professional with a passion for science and deep scientific knowledge
* At least 2 years of experience in a Medical Science Liaison or similar role (MG disease experience preferred); will consider candidates with > 5 years of MG clinical experience
* Must have well-established networks and active relationships with KOLs in the MG community
* Strong knowledge of GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex science into clear, actionable insights
* Energetically embraces responsibilities, demonstrates initiative, and excellent time management
* Agile, adaptable
* A collaborative mindset and genuine passion for improving patient outcomes
* Field-based, with the ability to travel approximately 75%

Education

* Advanced Scientific or Clinical degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP) with a minimum of 2 years of relevant clinical or pharmaceutical experience; NP or PA with 5 or more years clinical experience in MG will be considered. Must reside in the territory.

*Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. The company does not sponsor employment visas for this position.*

*TG Therapeutics is an equal employment opportunity employer, and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, national origin, ancestry, genetic information, military or veteran status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition or any other protected characteristic.*
